===========================================================================================================

  

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance. **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.*

 (Max 254 Characters)

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(Max 3975 Characters)**
==========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.
**6\) Relationships:** Describe the nature and purpose of most important contacts or relationship (except superior/team members) with individuals, departments, organizations inside and outside of the organization, that job is required to interact with to deliver the job objectives

title: HR Intern
description:
As a Human Resources fresher for our ACSaaS software company, you will play a pivotal role in managing the HR functions to support our dynamic team of professionals. You'll be responsible for implementing HR policies and procedures, managing recruitment processes, fostering employee relations, and ensuring compliance with relevant laws and regulations. Your goal will be to create an inclusive and supportive work environment that promotes employee engagement and enables our company to achieve its strategic objectives.

**Responsibilities:**

1\. **Recruitment and Onboarding:**

· Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process, including job postings, screening resumes, conducting interviews, and facilitating the onboarding of new hires.

· Collaborate with department managers to identify staffing needs and develop effective recruitment strategies.

· Coordinate orientation sessions to familiarize new employees with company policies, procedures, and culture.

2\. **HR Administration:**

· Maintain accurate employee records, including personal information, attendance, and performance evaluations.

· Administer employee benefits programs, such as health insurance, retirement plans, and employee assistance programs.

· Handle employee inquiries and concerns regarding HR policies, benefits, and payroll matters.

3\. **Employee Relations:**

· Foster positive employee relations by addressing employee grievances, conflicts, and disciplinary issues in a fair and timely manner.

· Promote open communication and collaboration across departments to enhance employee engagement and morale.

· Organize team\-building activities and events to strengthen relationships and promote a positive work culture.

4\. **Performance Management:**

· Support the performance management process by assisting managers in setting goals, conducting performance evaluations, and providing feedback to employees.

· Identify training and development needs and coordinate training programs to enhance employee skills and knowledge.

**Qualifications:**

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

· Solid understanding of HR principles, practices, and regulations.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Strong organizational and time\-management abilities.

· Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and integrity.

· HR certification (e.g., SHRM\-CP, PHR) is a plus.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹13,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – HR PROFESSIONAL

**Company:** Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Human Resources / Recruitment / Vendor Management  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Probation Period:** 2 Months  
**Work Mode During Probation:** Remote  
**Work Mode After Confirmation:** Hybrid  
**Compensation During Probation:** Incentive\-Based  
**Experience:** Freshers \& Experienced Candidates Can Apply

About the Role

Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is looking for motivated, responsible, and performance\-oriented HR professionals to join our growing Human Resources team.

The selected candidate will receive exposure to multiple HR functions, including **Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Employee Management, Candidate Handling, HRMS, Performance Management, Training \& Development, HR Administration, Vendor Management, and HR Reporting**.

The candidate will initially join the **HR Department**, and the final designation/profile will be determined after successful completion of the probation period based on performance, skills, responsibilities handled, leadership potential, and organizational requirements.

Potential Profiles After Probation

Depending on performance and suitability, the final designation may include:

* HR Recruiter
* HR Executive
* Senior HR Executive
* Talent Acquisition Executive
* HR Operations Executive
* Vendor Management Executive
* HR Manager
* Other suitable HR\-related positions

Key Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment activities.
* Understand manpower requirements and job descriptions.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, social media, referrals, databases, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes according to job requirements.
* Conduct initial telephonic/video screening interviews.
* Evaluate candidate communication, experience, skills, availability, salary expectations, and suitability.
* Shortlist suitable candidates.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with candidates.
* Collect interview feedback and update candidate status.
* Coordinate with selected candidates until successful joining.
* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Work toward improving candidate joining and retention ratios.

2\. Candidate Handling

* Communicate job requirements clearly to candidates.
* Verify candidate interest and consent before profile submission.
* Explain job role, location, work mode, salary structure, interview process, and joining requirements accurately.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Follow up before and after interviews.
* Handle candidate queries professionally.
* Reduce interview no\-shows and joining dropouts.
* Maintain accurate candidate status and communication records.
* Avoid false commitments or unauthorized promises to candidates.

3\. HR Operations

* Support day\-to\-day HR operations.
* Maintain employee records and HR databases.
* Manage HR documentation and administrative processes.
* Coordinate internal HR activities.
* Prepare and maintain HR reports.
* Support implementation of company HR policies and procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information.

4\. Employee Onboarding

* Coordinate pre\-joining and joining formalities.
* Collect and verify employee documents.
* Maintain employee onboarding records.
* Coordinate induction and orientation.
* Explain company policies, procedures, attendance rules, and work expectations.
* Support HRMS/account creation.
* Assist new employees during their initial employment period.

5\. Employee Management \& Relations

* Maintain professional relationships with employees.
* Address routine employee queries.
* Coordinate employee concerns and grievances with management.
* Support conflict resolution.
* Maintain proper documentation of employee\-related matters.
* Promote professional workplace communication and discipline.

6\. Attendance, Leave \& HRMS

* Monitor employee attendance and working status.
* Maintain attendance and leave records.
* Coordinate leave applications and approvals.
* Monitor late logins, early logouts, absenteeism, and attendance irregularities.
* Maintain accurate employee information in HRMS.
* Monitor login/logout and employee work status where applicable.
* Prepare attendance and leave reports for management.

7\. Performance Management

* Monitor employee performance during probation and employment.
* Track assigned tasks, responsibilities, and performance expectations.
* Maintain performance records.
* Identify performance gaps.
* Coordinate performance reviews.
* Support performance improvement initiatives.
* Provide accurate performance information to management for confirmation, extension, promotion, or other employment decisions.

8\. Training \& Development

* Identify employee training requirements.
* Coordinate employee induction and training programs.
* Maintain training attendance and records.
* Monitor participation in mandatory training.
* Collect training feedback.
* Support employee skill\-development initiatives.

9\. Vendor Management

* Identify potential recruitment and staffing vendors.
* Communicate with recruitment agencies and consultancy partners.
* Build and maintain professional vendor relationships.
* Share approved manpower requirements and job descriptions with vendors.
* Receive and review candidate profiles submitted by vendors.
* Check candidate quality, eligibility, and relevance.
* Coordinate vendor\-submitted candidate interviews.
* Follow up with vendors for candidate status and interview feedback.
* Track candidates from profile submission through joining.
* Maintain vendor databases and trackers.
* Monitor vendor performance and candidate quality.
* Coordinate pending requirements and recruitment closures.
* Support vendor onboarding and documentation.
* Support commercial discussions and negotiations when authorized by management.
* Ensure vendors follow approved company processes and commercial terms.
* Identify and develop new recruitment/vendor partnerships.
* Escalate vendor\-related issues to management.

10\. HR Documentation \& Administration

* Maintain employee files and records.
* Prepare or support preparation of HR letters and documents.
* Maintain joining, onboarding, probation, and performance records.
* Maintain disciplinary documentation where applicable.
* Ensure confidential documents are properly maintained.
* Support payroll\-related documentation and attendance inputs when authorized.

11\. HR Reporting \& MIS

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly HR reports.
* Maintain recruitment and candidate pipeline reports.
* Prepare employee attendance and status reports.
* Maintain joining and attrition records.
* Prepare vendor performance reports.
* Ensure HR data submitted to management is accurate and updated.

12\. Employee Engagement

* Support employee engagement initiatives.
* Coordinate internal meetings and HR activities.
* Support employee recognition programs.
* Collect employee feedback.
* Help maintain positive internal communication and workplace engagement.

13\. Exit Management

* Coordinate resignation and exit formalities.
* Maintain resignation and relieving records.
* Support exit interviews.
* Coordinate departmental clearance.
* Support Full \& Final documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee exit records.

Required Skills

Candidates should possess or be willing to develop:

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Recruitment and candidate\-handling ability.
* Professional communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic understanding of Human Resources.
* Candidate sourcing and screening skills.
* Employee\-handling ability.
* Vendor\-management and negotiation skills.
* Documentation and reporting skills.
* HRMS and basic computer proficiency.
* MS Excel/Google Sheets knowledge.
* Time\-management and multitasking ability.
* Problem\-solving skills.
* Team coordination and leadership potential.
* Professionalism and confidentiality.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Candidate Eligibility

* Graduate or pursuing graduation in HR, Management, Business Administration, or a relevant field.
* MBA/BBA/B.Com or HR\-related qualifications may be preferred but are not mandatory for all profiles.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and willingness to learn may apply.
* Experienced candidates with recruitment, HR operations, consultancy, staffing, or vendor\-management experience are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates should have access to a laptop/desktop and a stable internet connection for remote work.

Probation \& Final Designation

The initial probation period will be **2 months**.

During probation, candidates will be evaluated on:

* Recruitment performance
* Candidate sourcing and quality
* Candidate handling
* HR operations
* Employee management
* Vendor management
* Communication skills
* Attendance and discipline
* Documentation and reporting accuracy
* Task completion
* Problem\-solving ability
* Team coordination
* Leadership potential
* Professional conduct
* Overall contribution to the organization

Following successful completion of probation, **management will determine the candidate's final designation/profile based on demonstrated performance, capabilities, responsibilities handled, organizational requirements, and overall suitability.**

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is suitable for candidates who:

* Want to build a long\-term career in Human Resources.
* Are interested in both recruitment and core HR operations.
* Want practical exposure to employee and vendor management.
* Are comfortable communicating with candidates, employees, vendors, and management.
* Are disciplined, responsible, and performance\-oriented.
* Can take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Are willing to learn multiple areas of HR rather than limiting themselves to recruitment only.

**Join Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and gain hands\-on exposure across Recruitment, HR Operations, Employee Management, HRMS, Performance Management, and Vendor Management.**

title: Transition Manager
description:
1\. JOB PURPOSE

The Transition Manager will be responsible for **end\-to\-end transition and mobilization of new Facility Management contracts**, from contract award until successful operational stabilization and handover to the Operations team.

The role will act as the **single point of accountability for transition**, coordinating with Sales, Operations, HR, Recruitment, Procurement, Finance, Compliance, QHSE, IT and client stakeholders to ensure projects go live **on time, within approved budget and with zero major service disruption**.

The candidate should have strong experience in **manpower mobilization, soft services, hard services, commercial planning, statutory compliance, vendor management, client handling and project implementation**.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. Transition \& Mobilization

* Lead end\-to\-end transition of newly awarded FM / IFM contracts.
* Prepare detailed **30/60/90\-day transition and mobilization plans**.
* Conduct site surveys and understand client requirements, scope of work and operational expectations.
* Review contract, SLA, KPI, manpower deployment and commercial requirements before mobilization.
* Develop project\-wise mobilization schedules, milestones and responsibility matrices.
* Ensure timely readiness of manpower, supervisors, equipment, machinery, consumables, uniforms, PPE and other resources.
* Ensure smooth transition from incumbent service provider to the new FM service provider.
* Identify transition risks and develop contingency and mitigation plans.
* Ensure **zero critical operational disruption during go\-live**.

B. Manpower Planning \& Recruitment

* Prepare manpower deployment plans based on contract requirements and approved budgets.
* Coordinate with HR and Recruitment teams for timely hiring and onboarding.
* Plan local and outstation manpower mobilization wherever required.
* Ensure deployment of qualified supervisors, engineers and operational teams.
* Coordinate employee documentation, background verification, medical fitness, training and induction.
* Monitor manpower readiness against the project mobilization timeline.
* Ensure replacement plans are available for critical positions.

C. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary transition SPOC for the client.
* Conduct transition kick\-off meetings with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Establish regular transition review meetings and governance mechanisms.
* Understand client expectations and convert them into operational requirements.
* Manage client escalations during the mobilization phase.
* Coordinate with incumbent vendors / client representatives for smooth handover.
* Present transition progress, risks, issues and action plans to senior management.

D. Commercial \& Budget Management

* Review approved commercial proposals and transition budgets.
* Ensure mobilization activities are executed within the approved budget.
* Monitor manpower cost, equipment cost, consumables, uniforms, PPE and other startup expenses.
* Coordinate with Finance and Operations to ensure project profitability.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities without compromising service quality.
* Monitor deviations between **approved budget vs. actual transition cost**.
* Support Operations in understanding contract commercials, billing parameters and SLA requirements.
* Identify opportunities for additional services / upselling during transition.

E. Operations Readiness

* Ensure all operational SOPs, checklists, formats and escalation matrices are ready before go\-live.
* Establish site organization structure and reporting hierarchy.
* Ensure deployment of supervisors and key management personnel.
* Ensure equipment, machinery and consumables are available before commencement.
* Coordinate with Operations for service\-specific readiness.
* Establish daily, weekly and monthly reporting mechanisms.
* Conduct operational readiness audits before handover.

F. Soft Services

Experience / understanding in:

* Housekeeping
* Security
* Pantry / Food Services
* Pest Control
* Landscaping
* Waste Management
* Helpdesk / Front Office
* Support Services

Ensure manpower, SOPs, equipment, consumables and service standards are aligned with contractual requirements.

G. Hard Services / Technical Services

Should have good understanding of FM engineering services such as:

* Electrical
* HVAC
* DG / UPS
* Plumbing
* STP / WTP
* Fire \& Life Safety
* BMS
* Civil Maintenance
* Preventive \& Breakdown Maintenance
* AMC / Vendor Management

Technical engineering expertise is particularly relevant for senior FM transition roles handling integrated technical operations.

H. Compliance \& QHSE

* Ensure statutory and client compliance requirements are completed before go\-live.
* Coordinate with HR / Compliance teams for PF, ESI, labour law and other applicable requirements.
* Ensure safety documentation and risk assessments are completed.
* Ensure required licenses, certificates and statutory records are available.
* Coordinate QHSE audits and pre\-start inspections.
* Ensure 100% compliance with client and company safety standards.

I. Procurement \& Vendor Management

* Identify mobilization requirements and initiate procurement activities.
* Coordinate with Procurement for timely delivery of equipment, machinery and consumables.
* Finalize / onboard approved vendors as per company process.
* Monitor vendor delivery timelines and quality.
* Ensure AMC / service contracts are established wherever required.
* Maintain vendor performance and escalation records.

J. Technology \& MIS

* Drive implementation of CAFM / CMMS / HRMS / Helpdesk systems at new sites.
* Ensure employee and asset master data is created before go\-live.
* Implement attendance, payroll and workforce management processes.
* Establish dashboards and transition MIS.
* Track manpower, cost, SLA, compliance and mobilization status.
* Use **MS Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI / MIS tools** for management reporting.

K. Handover \& Stabilization

* Conduct final operational readiness review before go\-live.
* Prepare detailed handover checklist for Operations.
* Ensure all documents, asset details, manpower data, SOPs and vendor information are handed over.
* Conduct knowledge\-transfer sessions with the Operations team.
* Monitor the account during the initial **30–90 days stabilization period**.
* Track transition issues until closure.
* Conduct post\-transition review and identify lessons learned / process improvements.

3\. title: AI Engineer (Fresher)
description:
##### **LOCATION**
**Mumbai/Pune**

##### **EXPERIENCE**
**0 \- 1 years**

##### **FUNCTIONAL AREA**
**Development**

**Role Overview**



As an AI Engineer, you’ll be part of a next\-generation engineering team building intelligent, autonomous systems that combine Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic reasoning frameworks. You’ll participate end\-to\-end — from data ingestion and model training to Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration, and deployment of scalable microservices. This role demands curiosity, precision, and a passion for bridging traditional ML and modern LLM\-based agentic architectures into production\-grade systems.



Key Responsibilities


* Design and implement RAG pipelines for large\-scale data retrieval and contextual reasoning.


* Build, train, and fine\-tune ML models using Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch for structured and unstructured datasets.


* Develop modular AI microservices (FastAPI/Flask) integrated with vector databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Elasticsearch) and embedding pipelines.


* Orchestrate multi\-agent systems using LangGraph, LangChain, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) for dynamic task execution.


* Integrate and evaluate LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Groq, Anthropic, etc.) for reasoning, generation, and workflow automation.


* Implement data and ML pipelines (Airflow, ZenML, Dagster) for training, evaluation, and inference.


* Develop and expose REST or WebSocket APIs for model and agent communication.


* Apply prompt engineering and reranking strategies to improve contextual accuracy and system reasoning.


* Work closely with data, backend, and AI engineers to deploy, scale, and monitor intelligent microservices in test/staging environments.


* Contribute to shared AI infrastructure modules, ensuring reproducibility, maintainability, and performance.


* Research and prototype new architectures, including multimodal RAG, structured reasoning, or fine\-tuning pipelines.



Required Technical Skills


* Strong understanding of RAG architecture — document chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and synthesis.


* Proficiency in Python, including libraries like Pandas, Numpy, and Scikit\-learn.


* Experience with FastAPI or Flask for microservice and API development.


* Hands\-on with LangGraph, LangChain, or MCP for multi\-agent orchestration.


* Familiarity with vector databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Elasticsearch).


* Good Working knowledge of ML/DL frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).


* Understanding of model serving via REST APIs, batch jobs, or pipelines.


* Exposure to containerization (Docker) and scalable architecture patterns.


* Familiarity with Git, MLflow, or DVC for versioning, tracking, and collaboration.


* Awareness of cloud AI/ML services (Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI).


* Understanding of prompt evaluation, retrieval accuracy metrics, and contextual reasoning benchmarks.


**Secondary Skills**
--------------------


* Curiosity to explore Agentic AI frameworks and autonomous reasoning systems.


* Analytical mindset with a focus on debugging, optimization, and scalability.


* Strong communication and documentation skills for collaborative workflows.


* Innovative and research\-driven approach toward new AI architectures.

We're looking for a motivated and enthusiastic CRM Executive (Fresher) to join our growing team and support CRM operations for our SaaS products and customer ecosystem.

This role is focused on managing customer information, monitoring customer interactions and product engagement, supporting customer onboarding and communication, coordinating with internal teams, and ensuring a smooth customer journey throughout the customer lifecycle.

**Customer Lifecycle \& Engagement**

* Customer onboarding status

* Customer activity
* Follow\-up status
* Retention/churn indicators
* Campaign performance
* Customer response rates
* Assist in creating and maintaining CRM dashboards and management reports.

met.

3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section

  

Aditya Birla Money Ltd. (ABML) is primarily a Broking Company, deals in Equity, Commodity \& Currency.


Workforce of \~800 spread across \~40 locations with customer base of in excess of 3 lacs. Commodity


operations are managed through its 100% subsidiary Aditya Birla Commodities Broking limited. ABML is


one of the leading securities trading companies in the country. ABML operates in a fragmented equity


broking business and has a daily turnover of close to 3,000 Crores with a market share of 1%. ABM works


in a highly regulated environment with a host of regulators like SEBI, RBI, AMFI, FMC, IRDA etc. regulating


its day to day operations. In addition to the regulator ABML is also subject to close monitoring and


inspection through various agencies like NSE / BSE / NCDX / MCX / NSDL / CDSL etc. ABML also operates


in a highly competitive market mainly in fragmented industry with ABML competition from major


National Broking houses like ICICI Securities, HDFC Securities, Angel Broking, MOFSL etc. and a range of


local Broking outfits.

  

The Human Resources department manages the entire gamut of employee management and employee


development activities for ABML. This includes Talent Acquisition, Training \& Development,


Compensation \& performance management \& HR Statutory Compliance.

  

The Zonal HR Manager is responsible for all HR delivery to the assigned region in ABML. This includes


driving recruitment, onboarding, various HR initiatives on OD, Talent Management and also ensure that


HR connect is maintained at all levels.

* Recruitment of quality manpower within stringent TAT
* Creating an effective engagement framework to retain quality talent in wake of stiff competition


\& ever changing market/regulatory environment

* Creating an employee connect with HR across all regions and partner with other support


functions for a uniform experience to the employee

Job Summary

We are looking for a **CS / LLB professional** to manage the company's **corporate secretarial and statutory compliance activities**, along with handling employee\-related legal matters, disputes, notices, and coordination with external legal counsel.

The candidate should have a strong understanding of **Companies Act, ROC/MCA compliances, corporate governance, labour laws, and employment\-related legal matters**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Company Secretarial \& Corporate Compliance

* Ensure timely compliance with the **Companies Act, 2013** and applicable corporate laws.
* Maintain and update statutory registers, records, minutes books, and other secretarial documents.
* Prepare and maintain documentation for **Board Meetings, General Meetings, resolutions, notices, agendas, and minutes**.
* Coordinate and ensure timely completion of **ROC/MCA filings** and other statutory filings.
* Assist in preparation and filing of annual returns and other applicable forms with the Registrar of Companies.
* Maintain records of directors, shareholders, shareholding patterns, statutory registers, and corporate documents.
* Coordinate with external Company Secretaries, consultants, auditors, and other professionals for statutory compliances.
* Monitor changes in corporate laws and regulatory requirements and ensure necessary action is taken.
* Assist in maintaining proper documentation for corporate actions, agreements, resolutions, and other secretarial matters.

title: Operations General Manager
description:
Job Title: General Manager – Operations  
Reports To: Management

About the Role  
The General Manager – Operations will act as the owner's representative and will be accountable for the complete operations of the restaurant. The role owns sales targets, guest experience and retention, team performance, revenue management, marketing and corporate tie\-ups, and the overall scaling of the property.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Complete Restaurant Operations  
\- Oversee day\-to\-day front\-of\-house and back\-of\-house operations to ensure smooth, efficient, and compliant service.  
\- Ensure adherence to SOPs, service standards, hygiene, food safety, and legal compliance (FSSAI, GST, labour laws, etc.).  
\- Manage opening/closing procedures, cash handling, inventory control, and vendor coordination.  
\- Resolve operational issues, guest complaints, and escalations promptly and professionally.

2\. Sales Targets \& Revenue Management  
\- Own monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for food, beverage, and overall revenue.  
\- Implement revenue management strategies: pricing, day\-part mix, table turnover, average check growth, and upselling.  
\- Monitor daily/weekly sales reports, identify gaps, and execute corrective actions.  
\- Drive alcohol sales through staff training, menu engineering, promotions, and bar programs.

3\. Guest Experience \& Retention  
\- Define and maintain service standards that deliver a consistent, memorable guest experience.  
\- Implement systems for guest feedback, complaint resolution, and recovery.  
\- Build and manage guest retention programs: loyalty, CRM, WhatsApp campaigns, special occasion outreach, and personalized service.  
\- Analyze guest data to improve repeat visits and lifetime value.

4\. Employee Management \& Training  
\- Lead, motivate, and manage all restaurant staff (FOH, BOH, support).  
\- Handle recruitment, onboarding, scheduling, performance management, and disciplinary actions in line with company policy.  
\- Conduct regular training on service, product knowledge, upselling, hygiene, and safety.  
\- Build a strong leadership pipeline (shift leads, supervisors, trainers).

5\. Marketing Plans \& Brand Building  
\- Develop and execute monthly/quarterly marketing plans aligned with sales goals.  
\- Coordinate with internal/external teams for social media, content, influencers, and local marketing.  
\- Plan and execute promotions, festivals, theme nights, and special events.

6\. Corporate Tie\-Ups \& B2B Growth  
\- Identify and onboard corporate clients for meetings, lunches, dinners, and events.  
\- Build relationships with HR/admin heads, event planners, and institutions.  
\- Create corporate packages, billing processes, and service protocols for B2B clients.

7\. Hosting, Collabs \& Parties  
\- Act as the primary host for high\-profile guests, VIPs, and regulars.  
\- Plan and execute collabs with brands, artists, DJs, influencers, and community partners.  
\- Manage private parties, celebrations, and off\-site events to maximize revenue and visibility.

8\. Food Quality \& Menu Innovation  
\- Work closely with the Head Chef to maintain the highest standards in food production, consistency, and presentation.  
\- Participate in menu planning, costing, and innovation; introduce seasonal, regional, and signature dishes.  
\- Ensure menu aligns with guest preferences, profitability, and operational feasibility.  
\- Monitor food cost, waste, and kitchen efficiency; implement corrective measures.

9\. Alcohol Sales \& Bar Program  
\- Develop and execute strategies to boost alcohol sales: cocktail programs, pairings, happy hours, tastings, and staff incentives.  
\- Train FOH and bar staff on responsible service, upselling, and product knowledge.  
\- Monitor bar inventory, pilferage, and compliance with liquor laws.

10\. Acting on Behalf of the Owner  
\- Represent the owner in all operational, guest, and vendor matters.  
\- Make decisions aligned with the owner's vision, brand standards, and financial goals.  
\- Protect the brand's reputation and long\-term value in every action.

11\. Performance Reporting \& Communication  
\- Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports to management/owner.  
\- Track KPIs: sales, covers, average check, food cost, beverage cost, labour cost, guest satisfaction, retention, and staff performance.  
\- Highlight risks, opportunities, and action plans with clear timelines.

12\. Scaling \& Multi\-Property Growth  
\- Document and standardize SOPs to enable replication across future properties.  
\- Identify opportunities for format expansion, new locations, or revenue streams.  
\- Support site selection, pre\-opening, hiring, and training for new outlets.  
\- Build systems and teams that can scale without compromising quality.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)  
\- Achievement of monthly/quarterly sales and profit targets  
\- Growth in guest retention and repeat visits  
\- Improvement in average check and alcohol sales mix  
\- Food cost, beverage cost, and labour cost within budget  
\- Guest satisfaction scores and complaint resolution time  
\- Staff retention, training completion, and performance ratings  
\- Successful execution of marketing plans, collabs, and corporate tie\-ups  
\- Timely and accurate performance reporting

Qualifications \& Experience  
\- Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field (preferred).  
\- 5–8\+ years of experience in restaurant operations, with at least 2–3 years in a GM / AGM / Operations Manager role.  
\- Proven track record of achieving sales targets, improving guest experience, and leading teams.  
\- Strong knowledge of food \& beverage operations, costing, inventory, and compliance.  
\- Experience in marketing, events, corporate sales, and brand collabs is highly desirable.

Skills \& Competencies  
\- Leadership and people management  
\- Strong communication and interpersonal skills  
\- Analytical mindset with comfort in data, reports, and Excel/Sheets  
\- Problem\-solving and decision\-making under pressure  
\- Customer\-centric and service\-oriented approach  
\- Strategic thinking with an execution focus  
\- High integrity and ability to represent the owner's interests

Working Conditions

Production Executive – 2\+ Years Experience

**Job Title:** Production Executive  
**Department:** Production / Manufacturing  
**Experience:** 2\+ Years  
**Location:** Tamil Nadu  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Hygiene Products / Personal Care / Manufacturing

About the Company

We are one of India’s leading manufacturers of hygiene products, creating plant\-based and eco\-friendly personal care solutions. Our products are manufactured in certified facilities and have received multiple national and state awards for quality and innovation.

With a growing team of 55\+ employees, we maintain a supportive, ethical, and performance\-focused work culture that encourages creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. Our company is committed to innovation, sustainability, and customer well\-being, giving individuals the opportunity to contribute to a purpose\-driven organization that makes a real difference.

Job Summary

We are looking for a **responsible, hands\-on, and target\-oriented Production Executive** with **2\+ years of experience** in manufacturing operations.

The candidate will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day production activities, achieving production targets, coordinating manpower and materials, maintaining production quality, controlling wastage, ensuring proper batch documentation, and supporting continuous improvement in production efficiency.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment and coordinating closely with **Production, Quality, Stores, Purchase, Maintenance, R\&D, and Management teams**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Production Planning \& Execution

* Execute daily production plans according to production schedules and customer requirements.
* Ensure production targets are achieved within the planned time.
* Allocate production activities and manpower according to workload and priorities.
* Monitor production output throughout the shift.
* Ensure proper utilization of machines, manpower, raw materials, and other resources.
* Identify production delays and take immediate corrective action.
* Coordinate with Production Management to achieve daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
* Ensure smooth production flow with minimum downtime and interruptions.

2\. Manpower Management

* Allocate workers/operators to production lines and workstations.
* Monitor attendance, manpower availability, productivity, and discipline.
* Ensure sufficient manpower is available for planned production.
* Train and guide operators on production processes and work instructions.
* Monitor individual and team productivity.
* Ensure workers follow safety, quality, and production procedures.
* Report manpower shortages and performance issues to the Production Manager.

3\. Production Target \& Productivity Management

* Monitor actual production against planned production targets.
* Track **units produced per hour, shift, and day**.
* Identify production gaps and analyse their root causes.
* Improve machine and manpower utilization.
* Monitor production efficiency and productivity.
* Implement approved measures to improve output without compromising product quality.
* Prepare daily production achievement reports.

4\. Raw Material \& Material Coordination

* Coordinate with Stores and Purchase teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials, packaging materials, and consumables.
* Verify material availability before starting production.
* Monitor material consumption against production requirements.
* Report shortages, excess consumption, or material\-quality issues.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of production materials.
* Coordinate with Stores for material issue and return.
* Support material reconciliation after completion of production batches.

5\. Quality Control \& Process Compliance

* Ensure production activities are carried out according to approved SOPs and work instructions.
* Coordinate with the Quality team to maintain product quality standards.
* Monitor production parameters and process controls.
* Ensure defective or rejected products are identified and segregated.
* Report quality deviations immediately.
* Support root\-cause analysis and corrective actions for production\-related quality issues.
* Ensure proper handling of rework and rejected materials.
* Maintain cleanliness and hygiene standards in the production area.

6\. Wastage \& Cost Control

* Monitor raw\-material and packaging\-material consumption.
* Track production wastage and process losses.
* Identify major sources of wastage and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure wastage remains within approved limits.
* Minimize material losses during production and packing.
* Monitor rework and rejection levels.
* Support initiatives to improve yield and reduce production costs.

7\. Batch Production \& Documentation

* Maintain accurate **batch\-wise production records**.
* Record batch numbers, production dates, raw materials used, quantities produced, wastage, and rejected quantities.
* Ensure proper traceability of production batches.
* Verify production records before batch closure.
* Maintain Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR) / Batch Production Records as applicable.
* Ensure all production documentation is complete and accurate.
* Coordinate with Quality and Stores for batch reconciliation.

8\. Machine \& Equipment Coordination

* Monitor the operational condition of production machinery and equipment.
* Report machine breakdowns and technical issues immediately.
* Coordinate with Maintenance teams for preventive and breakdown maintenance.
* Monitor machine downtime and identify recurring issues.

description:
1\. Job Purpose

The HR Recruiter will be responsible for managing the **end\-to\-end recruitment process** for academic and non\-academic positions across Suraka School. * Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for teaching, non\-teaching, administrative, and support staff.
* Understand manpower requirements from respective department/branch heads.
* Prepare and post job vacancies on appropriate recruitment platforms.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, employee referrals, recruitment agencies, and other channels.

* Screen resumes based on qualification, experience, communication skills, salary expectations, and job requirements.
* Conduct initial telephonic/virtual screening of candidates.
* Shortlist suitable candidates and coordinate interview schedules with the concerned department heads.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Coordinate demo classes, subject assessments, and other selection processes for teaching positions wherever required.
* Negotiate salary/CTC within the approved salary structure.
* Ensure timely closure of open positions.

B. School\-Specific Recruitment

* Recruit teachers based on subject expertise, qualification, experience, classroom management, and communication skills.
* Coordinate recruitment for coordinators, counsellors, office staff, front office, transport, housekeeping, security, caretakers, and other support staff.
* Verify candidate qualifications and relevant experience before final selection.
* Ensure candidates meet the school's required standards and eligibility criteria.
* Maintain a ready database of qualified teachers for urgent requirements.

C. Interview \& Selection Coordination

* Schedule interviews with candidates and concerned HODs/School Heads.
* Maintain interview feedback and selection status.
* Coordinate multiple rounds of interviews wherever applicable.
* Communicate selection/rejection status professionally to candidates.
* Collect required documents from selected candidates before onboarding.

D. Offer \& Onboarding Coordination

* Coordinate the offer process for selected candidates.
* Ensure selected candidates submit all required documents.
* Coordinate with HR/Admin/Payroll teams for joining formalities.
* Track joining dates and ensure selected candidates report as committed.
* Maintain accurate recruitment and onboarding records.
* Follow up with candidates who delay joining or withdraw after selection.

E. Recruitment MIS \& Reporting

* Maintain daily and weekly recruitment trackers.
* Share recruitment status reports with the HR Head.
* Track:
* Open vacancies
* Profiles sourced
* Profiles shortlisted
* Interviews scheduled
* Candidates selected
* Offers released
* Candidates joined
* Candidates rejected/withdrawn
* Position\-wise closure status
* Maintain a database of active and rejected candidates for future requirements.
* Monitor recruitment turnaround time and vacancy closure.

F. Coordination with School Management

* Regularly communicate with School Heads, Principals, Coordinators, and Department Heads regarding manpower requirements.
* Understand urgent staffing requirements and prioritize recruitment accordingly.
* Provide regular updates on difficult\-to\-fill positions.
* Coordinate with management for approval of salary packages and final selections.

G. Employee Documentation \& Compliance

* Ensure all selected candidates submit mandatory documents before joining.
* Coordinate background/reference verification wherever applicable.
* Ensure recruitment documentation is complete and properly maintained.
* Maintain confidentiality of candidate and employee information.
* Follow all applicable HR policies and organizational recruitment procedures.

3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely closure of open positions.
* Quality of candidates shortlisted.
* Joining conversion ratio.
* Recruitment turnaround time.
* Candidate retention during probation.
* Accuracy of recruitment documentation.
* Reduction in dependency on external recruitment agencies.
* Maintenance of updated recruitment MIS.
* Timely submission of daily/weekly recruitment reports.

4\. Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage.
* Prior experience in recruitment/talent acquisition is preferred.
* Experience in **school/education\-sector recruitment** will be an advantage.

5\. Required Skills

* Good candidate sourcing and screening skills.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination abilities.
* Good knowledge of recruitment portals and sourcing channels.
* Ability to handle multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Good negotiation skills.
* Strong MS Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet recruitment deadlines.
* Professional and confidential approach to handling employee information.

6\. Preferred Experience

**Experience:** 1–4 years in recruitment/HR recruitment

The ideal candidate should be:

* Responsible and organized
* Good at follow\-ups
* Result\-oriented

* Able to work independently
* Comfortable working with multiple school branches

title: Recruitment Specialist- HVAC
description:
THE ROLE

We are looking for an ambitious and execution\-driven Recruitment Specialist who understands that recruitment is not

simply about sourcing profiles—it is about identifying the right talent, maintaining momentum across every stage of the

hiring cycle, and consistently driving vacancies toward closure. The ideal candidate will bring strong screening

capability, sourcing intelligence, structured data management, and a sharp follow\-up discipline. This is a target\-driven

role with clear monthly revenue and closure expectations. The Recruitment Specialist will be accountable not only for

delivering quality candidates but also for contributing directly to business revenue through successful vacancy closures

and client requirements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Profile Evaluation \& Shortlisting: Screen candidate profiles against job descriptions and vacancy requirements with

precision, ensuring strong alignment between candidate capability and client expectations.

* Vacancy Ownership: Develop a clear understanding of each client requirement and execute targeted sourcing and

shortlisting strategies to improve closure rates.

* Strategic Sourcing: Research, evaluate, and leverage emerging job portals, professional networks, databases, and

sourcing channels to access high\-quality talent.

* Candidate Database Management: Build and maintain a structured, searchable, and up\-to\-date repository of

candidate profiles for current and future hiring requirements.

* Data \& Reporting: Create and manage Excel\-based trackers, candidate pipelines, status reports, and recruitment

data with accuracy and consistency.

* CV Quality Control: Assess candidate resumes critically and ensure that only relevant and well\-matched profiles are

submitted for client consideration.

* Interview Coordination: Drive timely follow\-ups with clients and candidates to coordinate interview schedules and

maintain momentum throughout the selection process.

* Weekly Business Updates: Prepare structured reports on open and closed positions, pipeline movement, closures,

and key recruitment insights.

* Operational Excellence: Manage multiple vacancies simultaneously while maintaining speed, accuracy, ownership,

and attention to detail.

* Revenue \& Target Ownership: Work toward defined monthly recruitment revenue and closure targets, maintaining a

consistent pipeline of active vacancies and candidates to achieve business objectives.

* Closure \& Revenue Tracking: Monitor individual performance against monthly targets, identify gaps in the

recruitment funnel, and proactively implement strategies to improve closures and revenue contribution.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* Graduate in any discipline; an MBA or specialization in Human Resources will be an added advantage.
* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in talent acquisition is mandatory, with demonstrated strength in profile screening,

sourcing, interview coordination, and vacancy closure.

* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel for trackers, reporting, data organization, and recruitment analysis.
* A proactive and research\-oriented mindset with the ability to discover and adopt new sourcing channels.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking capabilities, with the discipline to manage multiple priorities without

compromising quality.

* Strong communication, follow\-up, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* A results\-driven approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Target Orientation: Comfortable working in a performance\-driven environment with monthly revenue, vacancy

closure, and productivity targets, with a strong focus on measurable outcomes.

* HVAC Industry Exposure: Prior experience or familiarity with the HVAC, air\-conditioning, refrigeration, MEP, or

related engineering industry will be an added advantage, particularly in understanding technical profiles and

industry\-specific hiring requirements.

* Willingness to work full\-time from our Baner office in Pune.

WHY JOIN LUXARA

* An opportunity to build and sharpen your expertise in a dynamic, high\-growth recruitment environment.
* Exposure to diverse roles, industries, clients, and recruitment challenges.
* A collaborative and performance\-oriented work culture with a modern professional workspace.
* Competitive compensation aligned with experience, capability, and performance.
* A platform to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow with the organization.

If you are passionate about talent, thrive on closures, are motivated by measurable revenue targets, and want

to build a meaningful career in recruitment, we would like to hear from you

title: Human Resource Executive
description:
Job Title: HR Executive – Hospitality  
Reports To: Management  
Employment Type: Full\-Time

About the Role  
The HR Executive will be responsible for building, retaining, and developing a strong workforce for the restaurant/hospitality organization. The role ensures the property never runs out of staff, maintains a safe and happy work environment, drives training and SOP compliance, and acts as the trusted bridge between employees and management.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Workforce Planning \& Staffing  
\- Forecast manpower requirements across departments (FOH, BOH, stewarding, security, etc.) to ensure the organization never faces staff shortages.  
\- Manage end\-to\-end recruitment: sourcing, screening, interviewing, reference checks, and onboarding.  
\- Maintain a ready pipeline of candidates through walk\-ins, referrals, agencies, colleges, and government employment exchanges.  
\- Coordinate with department heads to plan hiring for peak seasons, events, and new openings.

2\. Employee Feedback, Safety \& Well\-being  
\- Conduct regular employee feedback sessions, surveys, and one\-on\-ones to understand concerns, suggestions, and morale.  
\- Ensure a safe, respectful, and harassment\-free workplace in line with company policy and legal requirements.  
\- Address grievances promptly and fairly; escalate critical issues to management with recommended actions.  
\- Monitor attendance, overtime, fatigue, and workload to protect employee well\-being.

3\. Employee Engagement \& Activities  
\- Plan and execute extra\-curricular and welfare activities: team outings, celebrations, sports, skill contests, and recognition programs.  
\- Organize initiatives that support employee upliftment, mental health, and work\-life balance.  
\- Build a positive culture where employees feel valued, heard, and motivated.

4\. Training, Orientation \& Development  
\- Design and deliver induction/orientation programs for all new joiners (company vision, policies, SOPs, safety, grooming, service standards).  
\- Coordinate department\-wise training plans with HODs and the GM; track training completion and effectiveness.  
\- Identify skill gaps and arrange internal/external training sessions (service, food safety, hygiene, communication, upselling, etc.).  
\- Maintain training records and support career development discussions.

5\. SOPs, Compliance \& Documentation  
\- Help the organization build, document, and implement HR and operational SOPs (attendance, leave, discipline, grievance, exit, etc.).  
\- Ensure compliance with labour laws, EPFO/ESI, minimum wages, and other statutory requirements (in coordination with finance/owner).  
\- Maintain accurate employee records: joining documents, ID proofs, contracts, attendance, leaves, appraisals, and exit formalities.

6\. Payroll \& Salary Support  
\- Act as the first point of contact for salary\-related queries: attendance, deductions, overtime, bonuses, incentives, and advances.  
\- Coordinate with finance/management to ensure timely and accurate salary processing.  
\- Explain salary structures and policies in simple language to employees.

7\. Communication Bridge: Employees \& Management  
\- Serve as the primary communicator between staff and management, ensuring clarity, transparency, and trust.  
\- Convey management decisions, policy changes, and business updates to employees in a clear and empathetic manner.  
\- Represent employee concerns and suggestions to management with constructive recommendations.

8\. Collaboration with Government Agencies \& Colleges  
\- Build relationships with government employment agencies, ITIs, hospitality institutes, and colleges for recruitment and employee upliftment.  
\- Explore government schemes, internships, apprenticeships, and skill\-development programs that benefit employees and the organization.  
\- Coordinate campus drives, internships, and training partnerships.

9\. Budget Management  
\- Prepare and manage the HR budget: recruitment, training, engagement activities, uniforms, background checks, and agency fees.  
\- Track HR\-related expenses and ensure they stay within approved limits.  
\- Propose cost\-effective solutions without compromising quality or compliance.

10\. Motivation \& Culture Building  
\- Motivate the team through recognition, appreciation, clear communication, and fair treatment.  
\- Promote a culture of professionalism, loyalty, and high standards.  
\- Lead by example: demonstrate integrity, confidentiality, and commitment to the organization.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)  
\- Zero critical manpower shortages; time\-to\-fill vacancies within target days  
\- Employee retention rate and reduction in unwanted attrition  
\- Employee satisfaction/engagement scores from regular feedback  
\- Training hours per employee and training effectiveness ratings  
\- 100% compliance with statutory requirements and documentation accuracy  
\- Timely resolution of grievances and salary\-related queries  
\- Successful execution of engagement activities within budget  
\- Positive feedback from employees and management on communication and support  
\- Occasional Site visits to gel up with the employees. \& for management meetings.

Qualifications \& Experience  
\- Bachelor’s degree in HR, Hospitality Management, Psychology, or related field.  
\- 2–4 years of experience in HR, preferably in the hospitality/restaurant industry.  
\- Candidates with a background in food production (culinary training \+ HR/operations exposure) are highly preferred.  
\- Familiarity with labour laws, payroll basics, and hospitality staffing is essential.

Skills \& Competencies  
\- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; ability to talk to people at all levels  
\- Strong understanding and empathy; able to listen and read situations accurately  
\- High integrity, professionalism, and loyalty to work and organization  
\- Firm on standards and policies, yet approachable and fair  
\- Good organizational and planning skills; able to manage multiple priorities  
\- Comfortable with basic Excel/Sheets for attendance, reports, and budgets  
\- Ability to motivate, influence, and build trust across the team

Personal Attributes  
\- Never compromises on standards, safety, or compliance  
\- Professional, discreet, and trustworthy with sensitive information  
\- Calm under pressure; able to handle conflicts and emotional situations  
\- Proactive, solution\-oriented, and willing to go beyond the job description  
\- Loyal, reliable, and committed to the long\-term success of the organization

Working Conditions  
\- Full\-time role with standard office hours, plus flexibility for interviews, events, and employee activities as needed.  
\- Regular interaction with employees across all shifts and departments.  
\- Occasional visits to government offices, colleges, and training venues.

How to Apply  
Interested candidates can share their CV and a brief note on their approach to employee retention and engagement on: careers@cconceptt.com

* Graduate in any discipline (BBA / MBA in Marketing is an advantage, not a requirement)

* Confident, presentable and comfortable meeting senior businesspeople and brand executives

* Two\-wheeler with a valid driving licence preferred
* Working knowledge of MS Office / Google Workspace and WhatsApp Business
* Self\-driven, organised, and able to follow up persistently without being reminded

**Good to have**

* Experience in real estate, retail, banking sales, insurance, FMCG or any field\-sales role

**Power Planet Solar** is a growing rooftop solar company focused on helping homes and businesses reduce their electricity costs through smart, reliable, and high\-quality solar solutions.

We are looking for an **ambitious, energetic and target\-driven Sales Executive** who wants to build a career in the rapidly growing renewable energy industry.

If you enjoy **meeting people, understanding their problems, solving them and closing deals**, this role is for you.

Role Overview

As a **Solar Sales Executive**, you will be responsible for taking potential customers from the initial enquiry to the final closure.

You will interact with homeowners, business owners and decision\-makers, understand their electricity requirements, recommend suitable solar solutions, prepare/coordinate quotations and follow up until the customer converts.

Sales Conversion

* Conduct regular follow\-ups through calls, WhatsApp and meetings.
* Convert qualified leads into confirmed orders.
* Coordinate with the engineering, installation and operations teams until project handover.

Sales Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of leads, follow\-ups, quotations and closures.
* Update CRM/sales tracking systems regularly.
* Submit daily and weekly sales reports.
* Achieve assigned monthly sales and revenue targets.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Highly driven and target\-oriented**
* Excellent at communication and interpersonal skills
* Confident in meeting customers face\-to\-face
* Good at negotiation and objection handling
* Strong in follow\-up and relationship management
* Comfortable with field sales and travel
* Self\-motivated and capable of working independently
* Willing to learn the technical aspects of rooftop solar
* Comfortable using WhatsApp, Excel and basic CRM/sales tools

Experience Preferred

Candidates with experience in the following industries are preferred:

* Rooftop Solar
* Renewable Energy
* Electrical Products
* Electrical/Power Equipment
* Real Estate
* Building Materials
* Home Improvement
* B2B/B2C Field Sales
* Consumer Durable Sales

**Solar industry experience is an advantage, but strong salespeople from other industries are welcome to apply.**

Qualifications

* Any Bachelor's degree / Diploma
* 1–4 years of relevant sales experience
* Freshers with exceptional communication and sales ability may also be considered
* Two\-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred

Compensation

**Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
**Travel Allowance:** As per company policy  
**Performance Incentives:** Attractive incentives linked to sales performance

**High performers can earn significantly more through incentives.**

The exact compensation will be based on the candidate's experience, capability and previous sales performance.

Performance Expectations

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Build a healthy sales pipeline
* Generate and qualify new opportunities
* Conduct regular customer meetings/site visits
* Maintain disciplined follow\-ups
* Achieve monthly sales targets
* Contribute directly to Power Planet Solar's revenue growth

Why Join Power Planet Solar?

* Work in one of India's fastest\-growing renewable\-energy sectors
* Direct exposure to residential and commercial solar projects
* Performance\-based earning potential
* Opportunity to grow into a **Senior Sales / Business Development / Sales Manager** role
* Work closely with founders and the core business team
* Build valuable expertise in solar, energy economics and consultative selling
* Be part of a company focused on making clean energy accessible to more customers

The Ideal Candidate

**We don't just want someone who can take orders.**

We want a salesperson who can:

**Find → Connect → Understand → Consult → Convince → Follow Up → Close.**

If you are someone who enjoys sales, loves meeting customers and is hungry to achieve targets, **we want to hear from you.**

Guided by the brand promise “Every Moment Matters” and the “Yes I Can!” service ethos, Radisson focuses on delivering personal, professional, and memorable guest experiences. Its loyalty program, Radisson Rewards, offers streamlined, day\-one benefits across a wide range of hotels, while Radisson Meetings provides tailored, 100% Carbon Neutral event solutions. Radisson Hotel Group is committed to caring for people, communities, and the planet, aiming for Net Zero by 2050 and making sustainable hotel stays and travel choices easier through verified sustainability standards.  

**Role Description** This is a full\-time, on\-site Learning and Development Executive role based at Radisson Hotel Group in Sagar. The Learning and Development Executive will design, coordinate, and deliver training programs that support service excellence, brand standards, and operational performance across the hotel. Responsibilities include conducting training needs analyses, creating learning content and materials, and facilitating workshops and on\-the\-job training for team members and leaders. The role will track training attendance, assess learning impact, and provide regular reports and recommendations to management. The Learning and Development Executive will collaborate closely with department heads and HR to support onboarding, career development initiatives, and a culture of continuous learning aligned with Radisson’s “Every Moment Matters” and “Yes I Can!” values.

 **Job Description**  

The Learning \& Development Executive will be focused on upskilling all team members at the hotel and support the General Manager to maintain brand standards and quality of guest experience.

  

* Identify training needs:
	+ Work with the hotel leadership team to provide training support for any new product or service program launch for the hotel.
* Design Training Programs:
	+ Ensure latest version of training program is available and used to deliver any training. This must be in line with the CSO/ASO guidelines.
* Deliver Training:
	+ Must be certified to deliver DNA training programs, such as Yes, I Can! And Responsible Business.
	+ Delivers onboarding program for all new joiners (90\-day journey) as defined by the global team.
* Evaluate Program Effectiveness:
	+ Evaluate success of the programs (training feedback ratings and knowledge improvement scores).
* Maintains Learning Management System:
	+ Leads the role of Local Learning Partner for the hotel.
	+ Ensure all new joiners are onboarded by Human Resources team to access Radisson Academy Online.
	+ Tracks and communicates completion of Online Onboarding Path and Service Culture training to hotel leadership team.
	+ Ensure all managers are trained to assign training to their direct reports and check completion status.
	+ Assign departmental Typsy playlist to all new joiners and track completion.
	+ Ensure all live session attendance is tracked and marked on RAO.
	+ Ensure completion of annual compliance training.
* Maintains Brand Standards and Quality
	+ Acts as the custodian of hotel brand standards and guides hotel to refer to Brand Standards on SharePoint/Hotelkit.
* Ensure certification and contribution of Certified Departmental Trainer
	+ Conducts monthly OJS Trainer Meet to check the following:
		- All trainers are actively involved in conducting training for their department.
		- All trainers are publishing their training calendar.
		- Topics included in training calendar are in line with the findings in GRI/GSS.
		- All trainers are maintaining their training completion report.
		- All trainers are submitting the training completion report and training tracker.
	+ All new joiners are trained on mandatory tasks before assigning duties.
* Maintains training documentation and communication:
	+ Publishes hotel training calendar every month in advance so departments can nominate their participants.
	+ Invites nominations from all departments and publish final nominations sheet.
	+ Ensure all topic related pre\-work and post\-work is communicated and completed on time.
	+ Publishes Monthly Training Report to the hotel leadership team.
	+ Maintains training grid at the hotel level.

title: Payroll Specialist
description:
**About Aramya** 






 Our vision is to build some of the world's most loved fashion and lifestyle brands and enable people to express themselves. We are well\-funded, with $20M raised from marquee investors like Accel, Z47, and industry veterans.
 









 Aramya is a 100 Cr\+ NMV fashion \& lifestyle company backed by Accel and Z47\. We're building a customer\-led portfolio: Aramya (daily wear), Tavira by Aramya (festive), and a new brand in stealth, going live in H2 2026\.
 









 Current Retail footprint: 14 stores in Bengaluru (and a few more are yet to go live).
 





 Opening next: Hyderabad and Chennai. Pune, Ahmedabad and Mumbai in the pipeline.
 





 Website:
 



 www.aramya.in
 





 Our Team:
 



 https://shorturl.at/l6uYJ
 









**About the opportunity** 






 The Payroll Specialist owns Aramya's monthly payroll cycle end\-to\-end — accuracy, compliance, timeliness — for every employee, every month.
 





 The standard here is 'zero errors, on time,' not 'mostly right.' You'll run the full payroll process, keep us clean across Indian statutes (PF, ESI, PT, TDS, LWF, Gratuity, Bonus Act), and be the person every employee talks to when there's a question about their salary.
 









**Key responsibilities** 






 Payroll Processing \& Data
 



* Process end\-to\-end monthly payroll — attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, deductions.
* Maintain the payroll master — joiners, exits, salary revisions, transfers, and promotions.
* Disburse salaries, full and final settlements, and reimbursements on time; liaise with banks on disbursement files.
* Handle employee queries on salary, tax deductions, payslips, and Form 16\.




 Statutory Compliance
 



* Manage EPF, ESI, Professional Tax, LWF, Gratuity, and Bonus Act — timely remittances and return filings.
* Compute and reconcile TDS on salaries; coordinate with Finance on Form 16, quarterly TDS returns, and year\-end computations.
* Stay current on labour law and tax regulation changes; adapt processes accordingly.




 Reporting, Systems \& Governance
 



* Prepare payroll MIS, headcount cost reports, salary registers, and variance analysis.
* Support internal and statutory audits with clean reconciliations and documentation.
* Coordinate with HRMS and payroll software vendors on system updates, data integrity, and process automation.
* Uphold internal controls, data confidentiality, and payroll governance.




**Key Sills and Qualifications** 




* 3\-6 years running payroll for a mid\-to\-large workforce (500\+ employees).
* B.Com
 

 / BBA / HR / related degree; MBA or PGDM (HR or Finance) preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian payroll statutes — PF, ESI, PT, TDS, LWF, Gratuity, and Bonus Act.
* Hands\-on with payroll or HRMS software — Keka, Darwinbox, GreytHR, SAP, ADP, or similar.
* Advanced Excel — VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and formulas for reconciliation and reporting.
* Attention to detail under strict monthly deadlines — payroll doesn't have small mistakes.
* Integrity in handling sensitive employee data — non\-negotiable.
* Bonus: experience handling payroll for a workforce of 1,000\+ employees.

**HR Head – Manufacturing Plant (Pithampur)** 




**Company** 




 Alankaram is one of India’s leading premium furniture brands, known for design\-led solid wood furniture that blends craftsmanship, innovation, and contemporary aesthetics. With integrated manufacturing operations in Pithampur and expanding retail/showroom presence across India, Alankaram is building a professionally managed, process\-driven, and people\-centric organization for long\-term scale.

title: Electric Motor Flux Design & Development Engineer
description:
**Company Description:** Finova Motors is dedicated to advancing electric motor technology for high performance, delivering specialized solutions for Satellite and Electic Vehicle applications. Finova Motors emphasizes innovation, quality, and efficiency in all its products and development efforts. Team members join a mission\-driven environment that is committed to cleaner, more efficient motors. The organization offers opportunities to contribute to cutting\-edge projects that shape next\-generation motor technology.

**Role Description:** The Electric Motor Flux Design, Simulation \& Development Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing electric motors for aerospace and automotive applications. Day\-to\-day tasks include creating detailed electromagnetic designs, performing simulations and analysis, thermal analysis, structural validation, preparing engineering documentation, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to meet performance and reliability targets within schedule constraints.

**What You Will Do**

**Electromagnetic Design**

* Design BLDC motor topology (slotted and slotless variants) for specified torque, speed, power, and efficiency targets
* Perform magnetic flux design considering all constraints, air gap dimensions, back iron saturation, magnet grade and geometry, winding configuration, slot\-pole combination
* Optimize winding design for minimal copper loss, cogging torque, and back\-EMF harmonic distortion
* Validate designs analytically and through simulation before physical prototype
* Perform steady\-state and transient thermal analysis of motor assemblies under continuous and peak load condition.
* Design thermal management strategy, heat flow paths, cooling provisions, and material selection to maximize sustained power output without derating
* Correlate simulation results with measured temperatures during prototype testing

**Simulation and Software**

* Run and interpret electromagnetic FEA simulations, 2D and 3D static, transient, and motion\-coupled analysis
* Perform motor sizing and performance prediction using dedicated motor design tools
* Build and validate simulation models against physical test data
* Work with both commercial and open\-source tools as appropriate for the task

**Prototype and Production Support**

* Support winding and assembly of motor prototypes in\-house
* Define manufacturing tolerances and test specifications for contract manufacturer
* Conduct motor characterization testing, including dynamometer, back\-EMF, cogging, thermal, and correlate with simulation
* Support transition from prototype to production, DFM review, tooling decisions, BOM optimization

**What We Are Looking For**

**Education**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical \& Electronics Engineering\- essential
* M.Tech / M.Sc / M.E. in Electromagnetics \- preferred
* Freshers with strong project or internship experience in motor design are encouraged to apply

**Experience**

* Min 2 to 5 years of hands\-on experience developing an electric motor from initial electromagnetic design through prototype testing and into production \- essential for experienced candidates
* For freshers and postgraduate students: demonstrated project or thesis work in motor design, electromagnetic simulation, or EV powertrain is accepted in lieu of industry experience
* Experience with permanent magnet BLDC or PMSM motor design specifically \- preferred
* Experience with outer rotor motor configurations \- a strong advantage
* MotorCAD \- for integrated electromagnetic, thermal, and mechanical motor design
* Ansys Maxwell or equivalent open\-source FEA tool (FEMM, JMAG, Opera) \- for 2D/3D electromagnetic simulation
* MATLAB / Simulink \- for motor performance modeling and control simulation

**What We Offer**

* Direct access to the founding team and full ownership of motor design decisions
* Exposure to the full product lifecycle \- from blank\-sheet design to prototype to production
* Collaborative environment with ISRO advisors and academic research partners
* Competitive salary commensurate with experience
