**The Role**
 Trusted Media Brands is looking for a detail\-oriented and enthusiastic Manual QA Engineer with 0–2 years of hands\-on experience testing consumer\-facing websites, preferably built on WordPress or similar CMS platforms.
   

  

 You will be responsible for validating the quality, functionality, usability, and responsiveness of our digital products across browsers, operating systems, screen sizes, and physical devices.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, comfortable using browser developer tools to investigate UI and functional issues, and have strong exposure to mobile and device testing.
   

  

 We are also looking for candidates who actively use AI tools as part of their QA workflow. You should be able to demonstrate how you have used AI to improve activities such as test case creation, acceptance criteria review, exploratory testing, UI validation, test data generation, defect analysis, and overall testing efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform manual testing of WordPress and CMS\-based websites to identify functional, UI, usability, content, integration, and compatibility issues.
* Validate WordPress functionality including templates, pages, posts, reusable components, plugins, forms, navigation, media, widgets, and other CMS\-managed functionality.
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, UI, compatibility, and responsive testing.
* Test websites across multiple browsers including Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge.
* Perform comprehensive testing across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices, including both Android and iOS environments.
* Validate responsive layouts across different screen resolutions, orientations, browsers, and physical devices.

* Review user stories, requirements, and Acceptance Criteria (AC) before testing and identify missing, unclear, negative, boundary, and edge\-case scenarios.
* Create, enhance, execute, and maintain test cases and test scenarios based on business and technical requirements.

* Identify, reproduce, document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution.
* Create high\-quality bug reports containing clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, screenshots/videos, environment details, device/browser information, logs, and other supporting evidence.
* Perform regression testing for releases and validate fixes across applicable browsers and devices.
* Participate actively in daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement/grooming, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Provide testing estimates, progress updates, quality risks, and meaningful QA inputs during sprint activities.


**AI\-Assisted Quality Engineering**
 We are looking for someone who is comfortable adopting AI as part of modern software testing.
   

  

 The candidate should have practical experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or similar Generative AI solutions during software testing activities.
   

  

**Examples Of Desirable AI Usage Include**
* Using AI to generate or enhance test cases and test scenarios
* Reviewing Acceptance Criteria and identifying missing requirements or test conditions
* Generating positive, negative, boundary, and edge\-case scenarios
* Using AI to support exploratory testing
* Using AI to assist with UI testing and visual validation
* Generating test data and different combinations of input conditions
* Using AI responsibly to improve QA productivity, test coverage, and quality


**Also, The Candidate Should Also Have**
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent attention to detail with the ability to identify subtle functional and visual defects.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to clearly communicate defects, quality risks, and testing results to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a distributed Agile team.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with fixed release timelines.


**Education**

* B.Tech, B.E., B.Sc. Computer Science/IT, MCA, or equivalent qualifications are preferred.

**Good to Have**

* BrowserStack or similar cross\-device testing platforms
* Postman and basic API testing
* Performance testing concepts
* AI\-assisted test generation or visual/UI testing tools
* Basic knowledge of API testing using Postman is preferred.


**Our Benefits:**
 We value our people and offer a collaborative and engaging culture. As a Trusted Media Brands employee, you will enjoy work/life balance, generous time off and comprehensive benefits and programs.
   

  

**India Specific Benefits**

title: Junior Payment Dev/Test EngineerFull Stack Engineer
description:
**Junior Payment Dev/Test Engineer** 




**IntelloCore** 
 \| Engineering – Payment Assurance
 



 preferred
 **Location:** 
 Noida/Chennai (Hybrid)
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years
 



**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About the role** 




 Payments fail in ways ordinary software doesn't. A single mis\-set bit in an ISO 8583 bitmap, a response code that maps to the wrong outcome, a settlement file that doesn't reconcile — and real money is stuck.
 



 We're hiring a
 **Junior Payment Dev/Test Engineer** 
 to help build the validation that catches those failures before they reach production. You'll work alongside Payments SMEs, developers and product teams on payment flows, payment switches, and the automation frameworks that validate them.
 



 This is not a traditional QA execution role. You'll build across
 **payment domain \+ development \+ automation \+ validation \+ integration \+ performance** 
 — and grow into genuine payments engineering expertise.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




**Learn the payments domain properly** 



* End\-to\-end card transaction processing: authorisation, clearing and settlement
* Issuing and acquiring flows
* POS, ATM, EFTPOS, payment gateway and payment switch architecture
* Work directly with senior Payments SMEs on complex real\-world scenarios



**Work with payment messages** 



* Build working knowledge of ISO 8583 — MTI, bitmaps and data elements
* Create, modify and validate request/response messages
* Perform field\-level validation, message comparison, and mapping/transformation checks
* Validate response codes and transaction outcomes
* Develop a foundation in ISO 20022 message families and flows



**Build and validate APIs** 



* Design and execute REST API validation scenarios
* Validate JSON and XML payloads, HTTP status codes and business responses
* Positive and negative path coverage
* Postman collections, automated with Newman or equivalent
* Build reusable API validation utilities



**Automate** 



* Develop and maintain Playwright automation
* Execute automated regression suites
* Contribute to CI/CD\-based automated validation



**Investigate failures** 



* Analyse failed transactions and pinpoint the exact point of failure
* Work through application logs and transaction traces
* Reproduce, document and retest defects with clear evidence
* Partner with developers through to resolution



**Document what you learn** 



* Validation scenarios, conditions and expected results
* Execution reports and investigation findings
* Transaction flow diagrams and reusable payment knowledge assets



  





**What we're looking for** 




**Must have** 



* 1–3 years in software development, QA automation or payment technology
* Hands\-on dev/test exposure to payments — ISO 8583, ISO 20022, payment switches
* Playwright
* Working knowledge of Python
* Basic SQL and Git
* Solid grounding in the SDLC and software testing principles
* Strong debugging and analytical instincts



**Nice to have** 



* Card issuing, merchant acquiring, EMV, payment gateways
* JMeter, Newman
* Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI
* Maven, Docker
* Rest API validations



**You'll do well here if you** 



* Investigate problems logically rather than guessing
* Have real attention to detail — in payments, the detail
 *is* 
 the job
* Can read a technical specification and work from it
* Take ownership of what you build
* Genuinely want to learn how money moves



**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Engineering or a related discipline. Candidates with relevant development, automation or payments experience preferred.
 



**What the first two months look like** 




 By the end of your first 1–2 months, you should be able to:
 


* Walk through an end\-to\-end card payment transaction
* Read and interpret ISO 8583 messages
* Create and execute payment validation scenarios
* Write Playwright automation scripts and run automated regression suites
* Analyse a failed transaction from logs and traces to root cause
* Write defect reports someone else can act on
* Run basic performance tests
* Independently own a small payment validation module

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Azure \+ AWS \| Data \& Integrations \| Compliance \| SRE Growth Track** 




  





**Location:** 
 Noida (On\-Site)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time (FTE)
 



  




 About the Role
   


 Crenovent is looking for an early\-career
 **Cloud DevOps \& Platform Operations Engineer** 
 who wants to build a career across cloud engineering, DevOps, platform operations, data integration, security, compliance, and eventually Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
 



 We are
 **not looking for an experienced DevOps specialist** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone with strong technical fundamentals, hands\-on curiosity, structured problem\-solving ability, and the capacity to learn quickly while working on real production systems across
 **Microsoft Azure and AWS** 
 .
 



 This is deliberately a broader role than traditional DevOps.
 



 The engineer will work across four interconnected areas:
 



**Cloud \& DevOps → Data \& Enterprise Integrations → Security/Compliance → Reliability Engineering** 




**The person joining this role should therefore be comfortable learning across disciplines rather than restricting themselves to infrastructure deployment alone.** 




  





  




 What You Will Work On1\. Microsoft Azure \& AWS
 
 You will learn to deploy, configure, operate, and troubleshoot cloud infrastructure across both Azure and AWS.
 



 Your work may include:
 


* Azure App Service
* Azure Functions
* Azure Storage
* Azure PostgreSQL and other managed databases
* Azure Key Vault
* Azure Monitor and Application Insights
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Azure Virtual Networks
* Azure Container Registry
* AWS EC2
* AWS RDS
* AWS S3
* AWS Lambda
* AWS IAM
* AWS VPC
* AWS CloudWatch
* AWS Secrets Manager
* Containerized workloads using Docker



 You are
 **not expected to know all of these on Day 1** 
 . Strong fundamentals and demonstrated ability to learn cloud technologies are more important.
 



  





  




 2\. DevOps \& CI/CD
 
 You will help engineering teams move code safely and consistently from development into deployed environments.
 



 This will include:
 


* Git and GitHub
* GitHub Actions
* CI/CD pipelines
* Development, staging, UAT and production environments
* Environment configuration
* Deployment automation
* Infrastructure as Code
* Terraform fundamentals
* Docker
* Secrets and configuration management
* Release management
* Deployment verification
* Backup and recovery procedures
* Basic infrastructure troubleshooting



 You will gradually learn how to make deployments
 **repeatable, observable, secure and auditable** 
 , rather than relying on manual operations.
 



  





  




 3\. Data, Demo Environments \& CRM Integrations
 
 An important part of this role is understanding that infrastructure exists to support applications and data.
 



 Crenovent works with enterprise systems and CRM data. You will therefore develop practical knowledge of how data enters, moves through and is maintained within an enterprise application.
 



 You may work with platforms such as:
 


* Microsoft Dynamics 365
* Salesforce
* HubSpot
* Other CRM and enterprise applications
* APIs and webhooks
* CSV/Excel/JSON datasets
* SQL databases
* REST APIs
* Data import/export mechanisms



 Typical assignments may include:
 


* Creating realistic
 **synthetic/demo datasets**
* **Preparing demo CRM accounts, contacts, leads and opportunities**
* **Populating demonstration environments**
* **Importing and exporting CRM data**
* **Understanding CRM schemas and relationships**
* **Mapping fields between source and destination systems**
* **Moving data from CRM systems into Crenovent environments**
* **Validating data after migration or ingestion**
* **Identifying duplicate, malformed or missing records**
* **Supporting API\-based integrations**
* **Understanding basic ETL/ELT concepts**
* **Creating repeatable processes for resetting or rebuilding demo environments**



 You should develop the ability to understand not only
 **where an application is deployed** 
 , but also
 **where its data comes from, where it goes, and how it can be validated** 
 .
 



  





  




 4\. Security, Compliance \& Audit Readiness
 
 This role will progressively develop into a combination of
 **DevOps \+ Cloud Governance \+ Compliance Engineering** 
 .
 



 You will learn how enterprise software companies demonstrate that their technology and operational processes are secure and controlled.
 



 You may support activities related to:
 


* Access\-control reviews
* User and privileged\-access management
* IAM and RBAC
* Secrets management
* Environment separation
* Audit logging
* Infrastructure inventories
* Configuration documentation
* Security evidence collection
* Backup verification
* Vulnerability\-management processes
* Patch\-management tracking
* Change\-management evidence
* Incident documentation
* Business continuity and disaster recovery
* Security policies and operating procedures
* Cloud security posture
* Compliance evidence repositories



 Over time, you will develop familiarity with frameworks and concepts such as:
 


* SOC 2
* ISO 27001
* GDPR
* Data privacy and protection
* Security controls
* Risk registers
* Audit evidence
* Control testing
* Vendor/security assessments



 You will
 **not be expected to be a compliance specialist when you join** 
 . The expectation is that you can learn how technical systems, operational controls and compliance requirements connect.
 



  





  




 5\. Monitoring, Reliability \& Future SRE Responsibilities
 
 As your technical capability develops, the role will progressively move toward
 **Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)** 
 .
 



 You will learn:
 


* Infrastructure monitoring
* Application monitoring
* Centralized logging
* Alerting
* Health checks
* Incident management
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Availability and uptime measurement
* Performance monitoring
* Capacity management
* Automated recovery
* Production readiness
* SLIs and SLOs
* Reliability engineering



 The long\-term objective is to develop an engineer who understands the complete operational lifecycle:
 



**Build → Deploy → Secure → Observe → Audit → Operate → Recover → Improve** 




  





  




 What We Expect You to Know
 
 For this 0–1 year role, we are looking for
 **fundamentals rather than mastery** 
 .
 



 You should have basic knowledge of several of the following:
 


* Linux
* Cloud computing concepts
* Microsoft Azure and/or AWS
* Git/GitHub
* CI/CD concepts
* Docker
* Networking fundamentals
* DNS, HTTP/HTTPS and APIs
* SQL
* Databases
* JSON and CSV
* REST APIs
* Python or another scripting language
* Basic information\-security concepts



 Exposure through internships, personal projects, college projects, certifications, labs or self\-learning is acceptable.
 



  





  




 What We Do Not Expect
 
 You do not need:
 


* 3–5 years of DevOps experience
* Expert\-level Kubernetes knowledge
* Deep multi\-cloud architecture experience
* Existing SOC 2 or ISO 27001 implementation experience
* Advanced SRE experience
* Expert knowledge of Salesforce or Dynamics 365
* Experience managing very large production infrastructure



 Those are capabilities that can be developed progressively within the role.
 



 What matters more is whether you understand the fundamentals and can systematically learn unfamiliar systems.
 



  





  




 The Candidate We Are Looking For
 
 A strong candidate for this role is someone who:
 


* Has strong computer\-science and engineering fundamentals
* Has experimented with Azure, AWS or both
* Can work comfortably with Linux and command\-line tools
* Understands basic databases and APIs
* Can write simple scripts to automate repetitive work
* Is interested in understanding how systems work end\-to\-end
* Can investigate technical problems rather than waiting for exact instructions
* Documents work systematically
* Pays attention to configuration, permissions and security
* Can work with checklists, evidence and operational procedures
* Is comfortable moving between infrastructure, application, data and security problems
* Wants to develop broad engineering depth early in their career



  





  




 A Typical Problem You Might Solve
 
 A Crenovent demonstration environment needs data from a CRM.
 



 Instead of simply receiving a narrowly defined infrastructure task, you may need to:
 



 Understand the CRM → identify the relevant entities and fields → prepare synthetic demo data → configure credentials securely → connect through an API → move the data → validate it in the destination → configure the application environment → deploy the relevant service → verify logs → troubleshoot failures → document the setup → ensure credentials are not exposed → preserve the evidence required for audit.
 



 That end\-to\-end ownership is what makes this role different from a conventional entry\-level DevOps position.
 



  





  




 How This Role Can Evolve
 
 This role provides multiple potential development paths.
 


 DevOps / Platform Engineering
 
 Cloud Infrastructure → CI/CD → Infrastructure as Code → Containers → Platform Engineering
 


 Site Reliability Engineering
 
 Monitoring → Incident Management → Observability → SLOs → Reliability Automation → SRE
 


 Cloud Security \& Compliance
 
 IAM → Cloud Governance → Security Controls → Audit Readiness → SOC 2 / ISO 27001 → Cloud Compliance Engineering
 


 Data \& Integration Operations
 
 CRM Data → APIs → Data Pipelines → Integration Operations → Enterprise Data Platforms
 



 The likely long\-term profile at Crenovent is a combination of:
 



**DevOps \+ SRE \+ Cloud Governance \+ Compliance Engineering** 




**with sufficient data and integration knowledge to operate enterprise environments effectively.** 




  





  




 Qualifications
 * B.Tech/B.E./BCA/MCA/B.Sc. Computer Science or equivalent technical background
* **0–1 year of professional experience**
* **Fresh graduates with strong hands\-on projects are encouraged to apply**
* **Azure or AWS certifications are useful but not mandatory**
* **Relevant internships, GitHub projects, cloud labs or independently built systems will be considered positively**



  





  




 What We Will Evaluate
 
 We are less interested in how many cloud\-service names you can memorize and more interested in whether you can reason through technical systems.
 



 The selection process may evaluate:
 


* Linux fundamentals
* Cloud fundamentals
* Azure/AWS concepts
* Networking basics
* Git
* CI/CD concepts
* Docker fundamentals
* SQL and databases
* APIs and JSON
* Basic scripting
* Troubleshooting approach
* Security awareness
* Ability to understand data movement
* Ability to learn an unfamiliar technical system
* Documentation discipline



 Candidates may also be given a practical assignment involving a small cloud deployment, API/data integration or DevOps automation problem.

As a member of ASCS team, you’ll play a key role in driving Amazon’s business. You will be responsible for providing Service Level issue support to all ASCS Engineering teams who built tier 1\-3 systems and keep their software packages/configurations free from vulnerability, setup and monitor new metrics and alarms for their systems and drive root cause resolutions to the recurrent issues. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.
   

  

 This role requires an individual with excellent System/Tool coding abilities along with AWS services understanding. The successful candidate will be a self\-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. * Best Incentive Plans (No upper limit)

**Experience:** Both fresher \& experienced candidates can apply

**Job Description:**

As a Freight Broker at our company, you will play a pivotal role in connecting shippers with carriers to ensure the efficient transportation of goods. You will be responsible for managing the end\-to\-end freight brokerage process, from sourcing and negotiating rates with carriers to coordinating and tracking shipments. Here are the key responsibilities of the role:

**1\. Carrier Management:**

\- Identify and establish relationships with reliable carriers, negotiating rates and terms.

\- Continuously evaluate carrier performance based on service levels, reliability, and cost\-effectiveness.

\- Maintain a strong network of carriers to meet customer demand and ensure timely delivery.

**2\. Shipper Management:**

\- Build and maintain relationships with shippers, understanding their transportation needs and requirements.

\- Coordinate shipment details, including pickup and delivery schedules, to meet customer expectations.

\- Provide exceptional customer service, addressing any concerns or issues promptly and professionally.

**3\. Freight Management:**

\- Source and secure freight from shippers, matching it with appropriate carriers.

\- Negotiate rates and contracts with shippers and carriers to maximize profitability.

\- Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, including documentation and insurance requirements.

**4\. Operations and Administration:**

\- Utilize freight brokerage software and tools to manage shipments and maintain accurate records.

\- Track and monitor shipments to ensure on\-time delivery and proactively address any delays or issues.

\- Prepare and maintain necessary documentation, such as bills of lading, invoices, and insurance certificates.

**Qualifications:**

\- Strong negotiation and communication skills.

\- Excellent problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.

\- Fresher \& Experienced both can apply

\- Preferred if proficient in using transportation management systems or freight brokerage software.

\- Added advantage to have familiarity with industry regulations and compliance requirements.

\- Ability to work in a fast\-paced and deadline\-driven environment.

\- High level of professionalism and customer service orientation.

description:

This role exists to provide round\-the\-clock surveillance of vessel movements and performance metrics, enabling proactive support to Technical and Operations teams. It ensures timely identification of routing inefficiencies, fuel optimisation opportunities, and compliance deviations. Continuously track vessel progress and performance metrics using designated platforms and tools.

Identify and escalate routing deviations, fuel inefficiencies, or CP non\-compliance to relevant stakeholders.
* **Voyage Data Logging:**  

Maintain accurate logs of voyage data, alerts issued, and actions taken for audit and review purposes.
* **Performance Flagging:**  

Highlight vessels showing signs of sub\-optimal speed profiles or routing for further review by shore teams.
* **Support to Technical \& Operations Teams:**  

Provide timely updates and performance snapshots to assist in operational decision\-making.
* **Shift Handover Reporting:**  

Prepare and deliver concise handover reports at the end of each shift to ensure continuity of monitoring.
* **Tool \& System Usage:**  

Operate performance monitoring systems and ensure data integrity across platforms.
* **Feedback Relay:**  

Capture feedback from shore teams and incorporate it into monitoring practices and alert thresholds.
* **Incident Documentation:**  

Record and report any performance\-related incidents or anomalies observed during m
* **Project Delivery and ISSC Support :** During the working hours or shifts to deliver and work on projects and tasks as required by the ISSC/GM.

**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:**

title: AI Solutions Engineer - Voice AI
description:
**About GoKwik** 




 GoKwik is a growth operating system designed to power D2C and eCommerce brands—from checkout optimization and reducing return\-to\-origin (RTO), to payments, retention, and post\-purchase engagement.
 



 Today, GoKwik enables 15,000\+ merchants globally, processes \~$2 billion in GMV, and continues to strengthen its AI\-powered infrastructure. Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments—and bolstered by a $13M growth round in June 2025 (total funding: $68M)—GoKwik is scaling rapidly across India, the UK, Europe, and the US.
 



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 Voice is a new surface on top of GoKwik's stack: the agent that picks up when a merchant's customer calls. Every request that comes in is framed around one merchant's problem. This role's job is to solve that problem and turn it into a pattern, so the next merchant is faster to onboard than the last. Prompt quality is not a formatting detail here — on a voice call, the prompt is most of what the customer experiences, so this role directly shapes call outcomes and merchant trust in the product.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 Prompt Engineering \& Agent Behaviour
 


* Build and tune system prompts per merchant — structure the prompt, manage the variables inside it, control LLM behavior through instruction alone
* Write for voice, not chat: sentence length, Hinglish switching, and how the TTS engine reads punctuation all change how a prompt performs out loud
* Treat prompt hygiene as the main lever on call quality, not a downstream cleanup step



 Merchant Solutioning \& Pattern Design
 


* Take a merchant's specific ask, stated or implicit, and design the conversation flow for it
* Abstract the one\-off into a reusable prompt template once the flow works, through pattern recognition across merchants
* Resist starting with the integration just because it looks like the harder problem — the flow comes first, the generalization comes second



 Data \& Integration
 


* Wire up product data and discount\-variable flows through Shopify and third\-party REST APIs, so the agent is working from clean, reliable inputs
* Write light backend scripts for pre\-processing: variable localization, price computation, and similar logic
* Treat data reliability as a call\-quality problem, not a separate engineering concern — a well\-written prompt on bad data still fails the call



 Continuous Improvement
 


* Run test, listen, iterate as an ongoing loop, not a one\-time deliverable
* Listen to live calls to find where the agent breaks, then fix the prompt or the data behind it
* Watch for the real risk: not that agents sound robotic, but that every merchant customization stays a one\-off nobody can maintain, so the backlog grows faster than the team can close it



  





**Who You Are** 



* 1–3 years of experience in a technical, product, or solutions role
* Technical background helps but is not required — what matters is fluency with prompting, comfort building with AI tools, and enough understanding of how data moves through an LLM\-plus\-voice pipeline to connect it to business context
* Strong prompting instincts: can structure a system prompt, manage variables inside it, and steer model behavior through instruction alone
* Comfortable with ambiguity and iteration — this is a build\-as\-you\-go role, not a spec\-and\-execute one



  





**Why GoKwik** 




 At GoKwik, you'll build one of the first voice AI products inside a fast\-scaling eCommerce infrastructure company. You'll own agents end to end — prompt, data, and iteration — rather than handing pieces off to someone else. This role offers direct ownership of a new product surface, close contact with merchants, and the chance to set the pattern the rest of the team builds on.

**What You'll Own** 




 Prompt Engineering \& Agent Behaviour
 


* Build and tune system prompts per merchant — structure the prompt, manage the variables inside it, control LLM behavior through instruction alone
* Write for voice, not chat: sentence length, Hinglish switching, and how the TTS engine reads punctuation all change how a prompt performs out loud
* Treat prompt hygiene as the main lever on call quality, not a downstream cleanup step



 Merchant Solutioning \& Pattern Design
 


* Take a merchant's specific ask, stated or implicit, and design the conversation flow for it
* Abstract the one\-off into a reusable prompt template once the flow works, through pattern recognition across merchants
* Resist starting with the integration just because it looks like the harder problem — the flow comes first, the generalization comes second



 Data \& Integration
 


* Wire up product data and discount\-variable flows through Shopify and third\-party REST APIs, so the agent is working from clean, reliable inputs
* Write light backend scripts for pre\-processing: variable localization, price computation, and similar logic
* Treat data reliability as a call\-quality problem, not a separate engineering concern — a well\-written prompt on bad data still fails the call



 Continuous Improvement
 


* Run test, listen, iterate as an ongoing loop, not a one\-time deliverable
* Listen to live calls to find where the agent breaks, then fix the prompt or the data behind it
* Watch for the real risk: not that agents sound robotic, but that every merchant customization stays a one\-off nobody can maintain, so the backlog grows faster than the team can close it



  





**Who You Are** 



* 1–3 years of experience in a technical, product, or solutions role
* Technical background helps but is not required — what matters is fluency with prompting, comfort building with AI tools, and enough understanding of how data moves through an LLM\-plus\-voice pipeline to connect it to business context
* Strong prompting instincts: can structure a system prompt, manage variables inside it, and steer model behavior through instruction alone
* Comfortable with ambiguity and iteration — this is a build\-as\-you\-go role, not a spec\-and\-execute one



  





**Why GoKwik** 




 At GoKwik, you'll build one of the first voice AI products inside a fast\-scaling eCommerce infrastructure company. You'll own agents end to end — prompt, data, and iteration — rather than handing pieces off to someone else. This role offers direct ownership of a new product surface, close contact with merchants, and the chance to set the pattern the rest of the team builds on.

 ROS 2 Humble and Isaac ROS

title: Robotics Hardware Engineer - III
description:
Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017\. We build syncOS — the
   

  

 industry\-first no\-code platform that lets manufacturers and warehouse operators integrate, reprogram, and scale
   

  

 automation systems without halting production or calling in specialists. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) run
   

  

 24/7 for global brands — transforming production lines in hours, not weeks.
   

  

 As Botsync scales its AMR fleet across more demanding industrial environments, this L3 role owns the power systems and
   

  

 actuation architecture that keep every robot running reliably — from motor drive electronics to battery and power
   

  

 distribution design.
   

  

**The key responsibilities include:
   

  

 Power and actuation system design**
* Design, develop, and validate power distribution, motor drive, and actuation systems for Botsync's AMR platforms during customer\-specific adoption projects
* Own architecture decisions for power systems and actuation subsystems (motor drivers, power distribution, battery/BMS interfaces) across Botsync AMR products
* Design and validate power electronics PCBs (motor drivers, power distribution boards, battery interface boards) integrated into AMRs deployed across various industrial environments
* Analyze and author PCB schematics for power and actuation subsystems, ensuring electrical design aligns with system\-level requirements


**Validation, testing and production support**
* Diagnose and resolve issues at both the power electronics and firmware levels during lab validation, pilot runs, and field deployments
* Design and implement test tools and validation strategies to streamline manufacturing and ensure hardware quality
* Investigate and close issues arising during AMR production, with a focus on repeatability and long\-term reliability
* Document power and actuation system designs using flowcharts, state diagrams, logic breakdowns, and structured test results


**Technical leadership**
* Set technical direction for power systems and actuation architecture across current and future AMR platforms
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior hardware engineers on power electronics and actuation design
* Own component selection, vendor evaluation, and design\-for\-manufacturing decisions for power and actuation subsystems


**Requirements**
**Essential**
* 5 \- 8 years of experience in robotics, mechatronics, or related fields
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable discipline
* Deep expertise in motor control (DC motors, brushless/BLDC motors, servo systems) — driver circuit design, current sensing, and closed\-loop control at the hardware level
* Power electronics design experience: DC\-DC converters, motor drivers, battery management systems (BMS), power distribution architecture, and protection circuits (overcurrent, overvoltage, thermal)
* Embedded C/C\+\+ experience for implementing motor control and power management firmware on microcontrollers (ARM Cortex\-M, STM32, or similar)
* Comfortable authoring and reading PCB schematics for power electronics, including layout considerations for thermal management and high\-current traces
* Skilled at using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, clamp meters, and multimeters
* Prior experience owning a power or actuation subsystem end\-to\-end, from concept through production, at a senior level


**Highly desirable**
* Hands\-on knowledge of CANBus, Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485/RS232, and other industrial communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet) for actuator and system communication
* Working knowledge of ROS 1 or ROS 2
* Exposure to robotics safety standards (ISO 13849, ISO 3691\)
* Experience with version control systems like Git
* Basic understanding of TCP/IP and UDP networking concepts


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health benefits package
* Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve
* Opportunities for professional development and growth into management roles
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Senior Embedded Engineer
description:
Pace Robotics, incubated by SINE IIT Bombay and backed by Pidilite Ventures and IIMA Ventures, is transforming building construction with intelligent, multi\-tasking robots. We've launched India's first multi\-tasking construction robot in partnership with Sobha Ltd, the most renowned real estate developer across India and the Middle East and have secured pre\-order interests from top\-tier firms in the region. Our flagship product, Centa Painter, automates paint, putty, and sanding for building interiors. Now, we're scaling deployments to seize global leadership in construction robotics along with development on new robots for additional use cases across construction finishes.
 



  





 To support our next stage of growth and to take the product to manufacturing at scale ready design along with new feature/technology development, we are looking for an embedded systems lead who will lead design and implementation of the software for embedded devices and systems end to end from requirements gathering to commercial deployment.
 



  





**What you will do:** 




  




* Conceptualize, design, fabricate, integrate and test overall embedded architecture, embedded boards, software and circuitry for Pace Robotics’ fleet of AMRs.
* Develop embedded code which enables simultaneous exchange of data between various modules and sensors to facilitate fast/robust decision making for the robot and real time controls.
* Design and Implement Communication Protocols, actuation sequencing and deep involvement with embedded software and control strategy.
* Develop and maintain various engineering tools used to debug, analyze, and test embedded products.
* Work as the common link between the hardware, robot autonomy, and software teams, converting inputs from each team along with overall product/customer needs into electronic circuits, software and hardware.
* Selection and integration of all active, passive components, micro\-controller, processor w/peripherals and power components.
* Work on improving the efficiency of the power distribution and consumption.
* Work on designing the wiring scheme of the whole autonomous system.



  





**Who you are:** 




  




* Masters or Bachelors (with 8\-12 yrs exp) in Electronics \& Communication / Electronics \& Instrumentation/Electrical \& Electronics/Embedded Systems with relevant experience in industrial R\&D Projects.
* You have the following technical skill sets:
* Expertise with latest Gen Cortex A and M series microcontroller/processors, Nvidia Jetson Orin/Thor/Xavier platforms
* Expertise with C,C\+\+ and python programming with expertise in coding standards such as MISRA etc
* Expertise with digital electronics (BJTs, Mosfets, Amplifiers, OP Amps etc)
* Knowledge of different communication protocols such as I2C,Ethernet(TCP/IP,UDP), EtherCat, CAN etc
* Good Understanding of Electronics Circuits and Schematics
* Expertise with RTOS (FreeRTOS/VxWorks etc)
* Expertise with Linux (Ubuntu and RTLinux) programming concepts
* Deep experience with Signal Processing methods
* Experienced in PCB and wiring harness Design
* Proficient with Matlab, Simulink, DAQ software
* Experience with EMI/EMC compliant design procedures and testing methodologies
* Proficient in developing and maintaining codebase



  





 Good to have:\-
 


* Knowledge of robotics concepts and fundamentals such as Mapping, localization, path planning and perception
* Knowledge of Computer Vision, ML and DL
* Knowledge of control systems
* Knowledge of kinematics, dynamics
* Knowledge of GPU architecture and CUDA programming
* Familiarity with simulation platforms such as ISSAC SIM, GAZEBO, MUJOCO etc
* Strong quantitative and data interpretation skills
* Highly organized and methodical in everything you do
* You love solving problems and look at them as an opportunity to grow
* You keep up to date with latest developments and research
* Highly curious, love to learn, a strong team player and a motivation for junior colleagues



  





**What's in it for you:** 




  





 Globally, Construction provides a 1\.6 Trillion Dollar opportunity, just by making the work more efficient. This is the market we are after. You will be an integral part of the core team of an early stage startup on a mission change the way we build our world and disrupt one of the oldest and the largest industries. You will be designing products that can change the landscape of construction, become ubiquitous in project sites and be synonymous with construction of the future (Think of JCB and Tower Cranes of today)
 



  





 We promise you an environment that promotes unhindered innovation and one that can provide exciting opportunities for accelerated growth. You will be working with a stellar engineering team having diverse experience in developing robots for automotive, agriculture and construction industries. You will have immense learning opportunity as you will be working on ‘never\-seen\-before’ products for an industry that’s ripe for technological disruptions.
 



  





 The compensation includes company stocks through ESOPs.

title: Packaging & Dispatch Executive
description:
Job Description

**Packing \& Dispatch Executive**

Job Summary

We are looking for a responsible and detail\-oriented **Packing \& Dispatch Executive** to manage store activities, inventory control, material packing, documentation, and dispatch operations. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring accurate material handling, proper stock records, safe packing, and timely dispatch while coordinating with internal departments, transporters, and courier partners.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Good knowledge of **Store Management, Inventory Control, Packing, and Dispatch activities**.
* Fresher to 3 years of experience in **Packing, Dispatch, Warehouse, Logistics, Stores, or a related field**.
* Basic computer knowledge with familiarity with **MS Excel, MS Word, and Inventory/ERP systems**.
* Ability to read and verify **invoices, purchase orders, delivery challans, packing lists, order details, and shipping labels**.
* Good attention to detail and accuracy in checking materials and documents.
* Good coordination and communication skills with internal departments, transporters, and courier partners.
* Ability to maintain accurate **stock and dispatch records**.
* Ability to handle materials carefully and follow **safety and company procedures**.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.

**Key Responsibilities :**

1\. Store \& Inventory Management

* Receive incoming materials/goods and verify quantity, specifications, and physical condition.
* Maintain proper arrangement, identification, and storage of materials in the store.
* Maintain accurate stock records and update inventory regularly.
* Issue materials/products against authorized requests.
* Maintain proper documentation for inward and outward stock.
* Conduct regular stock verification and report any shortage, excess, or discrepancy.
* Assist in stock audits and other warehouse\-related activities as required.

2\. Packing \& Dispatch

* Pick, check, pack, label, and prepare goods for shipment.
* Verify product quantity, specifications, customer details, and dispatch documents before shipment.
* Ensure proper and safe packing to prevent damage during transportation.
* Coordinate with transporters, courier partners, and delivery staff for timely dispatch.
* Track dispatched shipments and follow up on pending or delayed deliveries.
* Handle returned, damaged, or rejected goods and maintain relevant records.
* Ensure all dispatch documents and shipping labels are properly prepared and attached.

3\. Coordination \& General Responsibilities

* Coordinate with **Sales, Purchase, Accounts, Production, Projects, and other departments** regarding material requirements and dispatches.
* Follow company procedures for inventory control, material handling, packing, and dispatch.
* Maintain cleanliness, safety, and proper organization of the store, warehouse, and dispatch area.
* Monitor the availability of packing materials and inform the concerned person when replenishment is required.
* Maintain proper filing and documentation of store and dispatch records.
* Report any material damage, mismatch, shortage, or other discrepancy to the reporting manager.
* Perform other store, warehouse, packing, and dispatch\-related activities as assigned by the reporting manager.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Diploma / ITI qualification preferred.
* Candidates with experience in **Stores, Warehouse, Logistics, Packing, Dispatch, or Inventory Management** will be preferred.
* Candidates should be physically fit to handle routine material movement and packing activities.
* Should be responsible, disciplined, organized, and willing to work as part of a team.

Department **: Stores / Logistics / Dispatch**

Experience : **Fresher to 3 Years**

title: Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 We turn the signals generated across every customer interaction into trusted data, meaningful insight and better business decisions. The CCA Data Pillar provides the enterprise data foundations, data products, analytics, reporting and AI enablement that help the business understand customer journeys, measure operational performance and identify where action will create the greatest value.
   

  

 As CCA modernizes its contact center platforms, expands digital channels and adopts AI\-enabled experiences, our role becomes even more critical. We connect data across platforms and lines of business, improve its quality and accessibility, and create a dependable source of truth for operational and customer insight. If the business needs to understand what is happening, why it is happening and what to do next, the Data Pillar makes that possible.
   

  

 Our purpose: make trusted data easy to find, understand and use, so CCA can improve customer outcomes, operational performance and the value delivered by AI.
   

  

 The Product Manager is responsible for translating business priorities, customer needs and Data Pillar objectives into a clear, prioritized and delivery\-ready backlog. Working closely with Product Leadership, Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, Operations and business stakeholders, the role ensures Agile teams understand the problem to solve, the value expected and the acceptance criteria for success.
   

  

 This is a delivery\-focused Product Manager role with a strong Product Owner orientation. The successful candidate will act as the day\-to\-day product partner for one or more Agile teams, while contributing to roadmap development, PI planning and continuous improvement across the wider Data Pillar.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Own, prioritize and maintain the team's backlog, balancing strategic product work, technical enablement, operational support, and mandatory commitments
* Translate business problems and product objectives into well\-defined features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes
* Maintain sufficient delivery\-ready work for upcoming sprints and Program Increments, with scope, dependencies, risks and sequencing clearly understood
* Lead day\-to\-day product engagement with engineers, architects, analysts, QA and Scrum Masters, providing fast decisions and requirement clarification
* Participate actively in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily delivery discussions, reviews, demos, and retrospectives
* Support PI planning by shaping objectives, confirming priorities, identifying dependencies, and helping teams make credible delivery commitments
* Engage business and operational stakeholders to understand needs, validate proposed solutions, gather feedback, and manage expectations
* Partner with Product Leadership to connect team\-level execution to the wider product vision, roadmap and business priorities
* Define MVPs and phased delivery approaches that release value early while supporting scalable, sustainable data solutions
* Maintain clear and accurate product information within agreed planning tools, including priorities, target outcomes, status, risks, and delivery dates
* Use product, delivery, adoption and data\-quality measures to assess outcomes, identify improvement opportunities and inform future priorities
* Champion quality, customer value, transparency and continuous improvement across the product delivery lifecycle
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* Proven solid Product Owner or delivery\-focused Product Management experience in an Agile environment, including backlog ownership, prioritization, requirements discovery, user story development and acceptance\-criteria definition
* Proven practical understanding of data, analytics, reporting, KPIs, data quality and enterprise data products is required, together with experience using product and Agile planning tools such as Rally or Aha!
* Proven ability to translate complex business and data needs into clear, deliverable outcomes; work confidently across business and technology teams
* Demonstrate solid stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, problem\-solving and organizational skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and analytics technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Power BI, data warehousing, AI, machine learning or advanced analytics would be beneficial
* SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, CSPO or equivalent Agile and product credentials would be advantageous, as would experience supporting distributed delivery teams and collaborating effectively with global stakeholders across time zones
* Knowledge of contact center operations, customer experience analytics, customer journey measurement, enterprise reporting, data governance or healthcare data


**What Success Looks Like**
* Backlog readiness
+ Teams have clear, prioritized and delivery\-ready work for upcoming sprints and PIs

* Delivery predictability
+ Objectives, dependencies, risks, and decisions are visible, enabling credible commitments and fewer surprises

* Requirement quality
+ Stories and acceptance criteria are understood, testable, and linked to clearly defined business outcomes

* Stakeholder alignment
+ Business, Product and Engineering share a consistent view of priorities, progress, and expected value

* Product outcomes
+ Delivered capabilities are adopted and show measurable improvement in customer, operational, data\-quality, or efficiency measures

* Team effectiveness
+ Delivery teams receive timely product decisions, clear direction, and constructive feedback


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
* 3\+ years of relevant Product Owner, Business Analysis or Product Management experience, preferably supporting data, analytics, reporting or platform products, with fulltime graduation degree
* Comfortable operating close to delivery while retaining a clear focus on business value and customer outcomes
* Able to work independently, manage ambiguity and build trusted relationships across distributed teams.
* Data\-literate and curious, with the confidence to ask the right questions without needing to be a data engineer
* Clear, pragmatic and outcome\-focused, with strong attention to detail and a bias toward action


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

Sales Support

* Number of new business opportunities developed.
* Follow\-up and conversion rate.

* Strong follow\-up and persuasion abilities.
* Ability to conduct market and client research.

5\. Educational Qualification

6\. Experience

**0–3 years of experience** in any of the following areas:

* Business Development
* Sales
* Client Acquisition
* Inside Sales
* Lead Generation
* B2B Sales
* Telecalling / Outbound Sales
* Marketing
* Customer Relationship Management

**Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in business development may also be considered.**

title: Digital Experience Designer
description:
**About Nyros Futureworks**

Nyros Futureworks builds **digital products, platforms, brands, and technology experiences** for ambitious businesses.

We are looking for a **Digital Experience Designer** who combines **strong visual design, UI/UX, and frontend development** to create digital experiences that are beautiful, responsive, performant, and technically well executed.

**This is a multidisciplinary design \+ frontend role.**

We expect you to take an experience from **concept → design → code → production**, rather than simply handing designs over to developers.

**What You'll Do**

* Design **premium websites, landing pages, web applications, and digital products**.
* Translate brands into distinctive and cohesive digital experiences.
* Create high\-fidelity UI/UX designs, prototypes, and **design systems**.
* Convert your own designs into **clean, responsive, production\-ready frontend code**.
* Build reusable UI components and maintain visual consistency.
* Ensure accurate implementation of typography, layouts, spacing, interactions, and responsive behaviour.
* Optimize experiences for **performance, accessibility, and cross\-browser compatibility**.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams.
* Use **AI\-assisted design and development workflows** to accelerate exploration and execution.

**Core SkillsVisual \& UI/UX — Essential**

* Strong understanding of **typography, composition, spacing, hierarchy, grids, color, and visual balance**.
* Good UI/UX fundamentals, including user flows, information architecture, and responsive design.
* Proficiency in **Figma** — Auto Layout, Components, Variants, and Prototyping.
* Understanding of **design systems and reusable components**.
* Excellent visual judgment and attention to detail.

**Frontend Development — Essential**

**You must be able to convert your designs into high\-quality frontend code.**

Working knowledge of:

* **HTML5 / CSS3**
* **JavaScript / TypeScript**
* **React, Vue, or similar modern frontend frameworks**
* Responsive web development
* Component\-based architecture
* Reusable UI components
* Git / version control
* Basic API integration

Your implementation should aim to be **pixel\-accurate, responsive, accessible, performant, maintainable, and production\-ready**.

**Motion \& Interaction — Highly Desirable**

Motion design is **not mandatory**, but it is a strong advantage.

Experience or familiarity with **GSAP, Lottie, Rive, After Effects, CSS animations, scroll interactions, page transitions, or micro\-interactions** will make you stand out.

Candidates who can both **design and implement interactions** will be especially valuable.

**Brand \& Visual Skills**

* Ability to translate a brand identity into a **consistent digital visual language**.
* Experience with Photoshop and Illustrator.
* Understanding of imagery, illustration, iconography, 3D, and visual storytelling.

**AI \& Emerging Technology**

We expect designers to be comfortable using **AI as part of their creative and development workflow**.

Experience with ChatGPT, AI coding assistants, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, AI image tools, or AI\-assisted prototyping is an advantage.

We value people who use AI to **accelerate exploration and execution without compromising originality or quality**.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate has:

* **Excellent visual taste and design judgment**
* Strong UI/UX fundamentals
* **Good frontend development capability**
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to move from **design to implementation**
* Understanding of responsive design and web fundamentals
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills
* Curiosity about technology and emerging digital experiences
* A willingness to learn and continuously improve

Most importantly, you should care about **both how an experience looks and how well it works.**

Portfolio \& Projects

**Portfolio is mandatory.**

**We want to see your strongest work, including where possible:**

* **Premium websites / digital experiences**
* Product or SaaS UI/UX
* Responsive web experiences
* Brand\-to\-digital experiences
* Design systems
* Interactive experiences

**Live website/project links are highly preferred.**

GitHub or relevant code samples are a strong advantage.

If you designed **and developed** a project yourself, clearly indicate your contribution.

Freshers Are Welcome

Candidates with **0–2 years of experience** are encouraged to apply.

Freshers and recent graduates with **exceptional portfolios, personal projects, internships, or self\-built websites** are welcome.

For entry\-level candidates, **demonstrated ability matters more than years of experience.**

**What Will Make You Stand Out**

* Built **premium websites from your own designs**
* Strong design \+ frontend capabilities
* Experience with **React, Vue, or similar frameworks**
* Strong attention to responsive implementation
* Motion and interaction experience
* **GSAP / Rive / Lottie**
* 3D / WebGL experience
* Experience with SaaS, AI, or technology products
* Strong design\-system thinking
* **AI\-assisted design \+ development workflows**

**Education**

A degree in **Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Engineering**, or a related field is preferred.

However, **portfolio quality, demonstrated capability, and real\-world projects matter more than formal qualifications.**

**Why Nyros?**

At Nyros, designers work closely with **product and engineering teams** rather than operating as a separate visual function.

You'll work at the intersection of:

**Design × Frontend × Brand × Motion × AI × Technology**

and have the opportunity to grow across both **creative and technical disciplines**.

Interested?

If you're someone who can **design beautiful experiences and turn those designs into high\-quality frontend code**, we'd love to hear from you.

**This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office position in Kakinada.**

Apply with your **resume, portfolio, live projects, and code samples**.

You will work at the intersection of user experience, product strategy, and frontend development, partnering closely with product, engineering, business, and design teams. Your work will span research, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing, and implementation. You will help translate user insights and business requirements into functional, polished, and visually compelling product experiences. The role offers an opportunity to influence product strategy while working on modern web applications built with technologies such as React and Laravel. You will also champion accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and consistency across the user experience. * Create polished and visually engaging interfaces that balance usability, business objectives, technical feasibility, and user needs.
* Work closely with developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and effectively.
* Optimize user experiences for responsiveness, accessibility, performance, and usability across devices and platforms.
* Help establish and maintain consistent design patterns and experiences across web applications.
* Present design concepts, research findings, recommendations, and prototypes to stakeholders and senior decision\-makers.


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of professional experience in UX Design, preferably within a product\-focused organization.

* Strong portfolio demonstrating UX and product design work for enterprise software, self\-service platforms, or other complex web applications.
* Strong expertise in creating wireframes, workflows, prototypes, mockups, and interactive experiences.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to balance user needs, business objectives, technical constraints, and product strategy.
* Experience working closely with developers and understanding modern web application development is an advantage.
* Familiarity with React, Laravel, PHP, AWS, or comparable web technologies is a plus.

* Experience in understanding customer requirements and converting them into practical technical solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Customer Discovery and Assessment
* Engage with customers to understand their business objectives, current technology environment, challenges and expected outcomes.
* Assess the complete technology landscape rather than viewing an individual product or requirement in isolation.
* Identify requirements, gaps, constraints, dependencies, assumptions and technical risks.
* Document the current state, expected outcomes and agreed solution requirements.
* Integrated Solution Design
* Design integrated solutions across cybersecurity, IAM/PAM, infrastructure, cloud, networking, applications and data.
* Define the overall architecture and explain how the different technology components will interact.
* Prepare High\-Level Design documents, architecture diagrams and clear technical solution descriptions.
* Ensure that solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, supportable and appropriate to the customer’s needs and budget.
* Identify integration requirements, prerequisites, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies and customer responsibilities.
* Recommend fit\-for\-purpose solutions while avoiding unnecessary complexity.
* Technical Coordination and Validation
* Engage TSPL’s Network, Cloud, IAM/PAM, Cybersecurity and other relevant engineers for detailed domain inputs.
* Recognise when OEM, partner, consultant or external specialist expertise is required.
* Ask the right technical questions, evaluate specialist recommendations and resolve gaps between different inputs.
* Validate that the proposed products, effort estimates, implementation approach and timelines are technically feasible.
* Remain accountable for the coherence and completeness of the overall solution.
* Technical Presales and Proposal Support
* Support Sales and Key Account Management teams during customer discovery, site assessments and technical discussions.
* Explain technical concepts and proposed solutions clearly to business, management and technical stakeholders.
* Prepare technical sections of proposals, Statements of Work and customer responses.
* Coordinate Bills of Material, licensing requirements, effort estimates and implementation timelines with the relevant teams.
* Ensure that technical commitments are achievable and that risks and dependencies are documented before proposal finalisation.
* Implementation Handover and Design Governance
* Conduct structured solution handovers with Implementation and Operations teams.
* Explain the approved architecture, design decisions, assumptions, dependencies, risks and customer commitments.
* Provide design clarification during implementation and assess significant changes to the approved solution.
* Participate in technical reviews and major project milestones where required.
* Confirm that the implemented solution remains aligned with the approved architecture.
* Documentation and Continuous Learning
* Maintain standard discovery questionnaires, solution templates, architecture diagrams and reusable solution patterns.
* Document important design decisions, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
* Maintain working relationships with OEMs, distributors, technology partners and technical specialists.
* Remain informed about relevant developments across infrastructure, cloud, networking, cybersecurity, IAM/PAM, applications and data.


**Critical Technical Knowledge**
**Holistic Enterprise Technology Understanding**
**The candidate must understand the purpose and interdependencies of the major components of an enterprise technology environment, including:**
* Servers, operating systems, storage, virtualisation, Active Directory/Entra ID, DNS, DHCP, backup and disaster recovery
* LAN, WAN, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, network segmentation, secure remote access and load balancing
* Public cloud and hybrid environments, including Azure or AWS architecture, connectivity, identity, security and monitoring fundamentals
* Identity lifecycle, authentication, authorisation, least privilege, SSO, MFA and access governance
* Cybersecurity controls across identity, endpoint, network, cloud, applications and data
* Enterprise applications, SaaS and on\-premise hosting, databases, data flows, APIs and system integrations
* Monitoring, logging, IT service management, incident and change management, technology risk and compliance


 The Solution Architect should be able to identify how these components interact, recognise risks and dependencies, assess operational implications and determine when deeper specialist expertise is required.
   

  

**Primary Technical Depth – Cybersecurity And IAM/PAM**
* Security\-by\-design, Zero Trust and defence\-in\-depth principles
* Risk\-based selection and integration of network, endpoint, cloud, application and data\-security controls
* Identity lifecycle, role\-based access control, SSO, federation, MFA and least privilege
* Privileged account onboarding, vaulting, credential rotation, session management and service\-account management
* IAM/PAM integration with Active Directory/Entra ID, cloud, servers, endpoints, networks and applications
* Working experience with CyberArk or a comparable IAM/PAM platform


**Education and Certifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications or a related field.
* Relevant cybersecurity, IAM/PAM, cloud, infrastructure or architecture certifications will be an advantage.
* Practical solution\-design and customer\-facing experience will carry greater weight than the number of certifications.


**Key Performance Expectations**

* Accuracy of technical scope, assumptions, dependencies, Bills of Material and proposal inputs
* Timely completion of solution documents and technical proposals
* Effective coordination of specialists and successful handover to Implementation and Operations teams

 **Organizational Context**
Key Aspects:* Part of the Aditya Birla Capital Limited, Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited (ABHFL) is registered with the National Housing Bank as a housing finance company under the National Housing Bank Act, 1987\. The company offers a complete range of housing finance solutions such as home loans, home improvement and home construction loans, balance transfer and top\-up loans, loans against property and construction finance. The company acquired its license on 9th July 2014 and has aggressive growth plans.
* ABHFL has grown at a steady rate while reporting good asset quality despite challenges in the operating environment. While the industry is dominated by five large groups, there has been an emergence of segments like Affordable and self\-employed borrowers, given the high potential in these segments. Despite increased focus by banks, HFCs have been able to maintain their share in the mortgage market. and is poised for rapid growth and plans to grow 5X (40,000 Cr) in the next 5 years. This shall take ABHFL within the top 5 percentile of HFCs in the country.
* The ABHFL Sales organization works broadly with 3 customer segments – retail (individual) customers, institutional customers (for retail and institutional loan consumers) and builders (for both retail tie\-ups and construction finance), with a major share of the business coming from retail customers. Client segments can also be divided into Salaried and Self\-employed, with both of these having very different preferences and needs.
**Job Context**
Key Aspects:* Providing housing finance (to buyers), Loan against Property, Commercial Property Purchase, Lease Rental Discounting and Construction Finance (to builders) solutions, ABHFL caters to a diverse range of customer segments through its various service offerings. Additionally, being predominantly retail driven, the business is characterized by high volume of loan transactions and customer relationships. As a result, ABHFL business performance is strongly impacted by people, process and organizational efficiencies, alongside core business drivers such as product/ solution quality, channel and customer relationship management and risk management.
* While unit of sizing up the business is its loan book size, profitability and minimized delinquency are also key business objectives.
* Higher cost of funding impacts profitability as well as competitiveness of loan rates that can be offered to clients
* For retail customers, identifying and acting on relevant needs for target demographics/ customer segments/ etc., in an efficient manner ensuring process, statutory and regulatory compliance at all times, are key for building business performance and sustainability.
* For institutional/ builder customers, understanding and addressing complex business requirements via proactive relationship management and customized solution fitment, while ensuring compliance at all times, are important to gain competitive advantage in this segment.

**Key Challenges*** To assign sales targets to team members considering local factors impacting business, such as competitor presence, existing relationships, new prospect opportunities, etc., and ensure achievement of set targets
* To upgrade financial \& operational know how of self and team members on industry dynamics, effective negotiation and relationship building, and efficient loan processing for maintaining lasting relationships with customers while ensuring portfolio health and profitability
* To drive loan conversion/ sanction/ utilization rates and ensure an appropriate sourcing funnel to meet targets
* To ensure credit quality, effective portfolio selection/ pre\-screening, and work closely with Risk team members to minimize potential NPAs while driving sales
* To ensure compliant sales operations at all times, despite sales pressures and market cycles
 **Enabling Skill Sets \& Qualifications*** Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include commercial acumen, team management and communication, product\-market awareness, and execution skills.

**Role Title –** Risk and Controls Manager Line 1


**Location** \- Bangalore\- Manyata tech Park  



**Business and team:**

We’re a team of talented technology and banking operations experts, working together to deliver cutting\-edge, innovative and exceptional experiences for our customers. We work across operational disciplines, including the financial crime lifecycle, which includes investigations, payment monitoring and customer due diligence. Our team of global best technologists harness the rapid acceleration of technology to create resilient, reliable banking experiences that make a real difference for customers. This requires the brightest minds in AI, data and cyber security.


**Impact and Contributions:**

The Technology Chief Controls Office (TCCO) is a Line 1 risk function that enables Technology to deliver safe, sound, and secure outcomes for our customers and the community. TCCO supports this through pragmatic risk management frameworks, tools, and advisory, providing deep risk expertise to uplift capability. We focus on controls, simplifying risk processes, and embedding practices that are practical and scalable. This role sits within the Retail Technology (RT) Centre of Excellence (CoE) in TCCO and partners closely with stakeholders across Retail, Cyber, Technology Platforms \& Products, Line 2 and Group Audit to strengthen and mature risk management across the Group.


The Technology Chief Controls Office (TCCO) is a Line 1 Risk team responsible for supporting CBA in continuing to mature its risk culture and establish \& maintain strong risk practices. You’ll play a supporting role within a high\-performing team accountable for strengthening, embedding, and continuously improving the risk and control environment across Retail Technology portfolio. This role is central to the execution of Line 1 risk obligations within Retail particularly across issue lifecycle management, control assessments, and CMRS integrity, which underpin an accurate and defensible risk position. The operating cadence of this role relies on consistent and timely updates to issues, actions, and control assessments to support governance forums and maintain data integrity across CMRS.  



**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Support senior stakeholders across Retail Technology, TCCO and Business teams by providing risk and control insights to inform decision making.
* Work effectively in a complex environment, contributing to the delivery and continuous improvement of Retail Technology initiatives.
* Build strong working relationships across TCCO, Cyber, Technology and Business teams to support effective risk management.
* Contribute to the use of AI and automation to enhance risk detection and control effectiveness.
* Support the development of more data\-driven approaches to risk management, including use of data quality metrics, lineage, and monitoring.
* Assist in the design, assessment, and uplift of controls across data platforms, pipelines, and data products.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, and automate controls to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Support stakeholders in embedding fit\-for\-purpose controls across its lifecycle.
* Analyse risk \& control trends, issues and incidents to identify patterns, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute to uplift initiatives that strengthen risk management practices and control environments.
* Translate technical and risk concepts into simple, actionable messages for both technical and non\-technical audiences .

**Essential Skills:**

* 8\+ years’ experience in risk, control advisory, change management risk, data governance, or technology risk within banking, financial services, consulting, or a related industry.
* Experience supporting risk and control activities across technology environments (e.g. control testing, risk assessments, issue management, or control design), data platforms, analytics, and supporting governance \& risk reporting activities.
* Ability to work with and support stakeholders across business and technology teams, with some exposure to senior stakeholders.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to use data to identify risks, trends, and improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to translate risk and control concepts for both technical (e.g. engineering/technology support teams) and non\-technical audiences.

**Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data, Engineering, or a related discipline. Relevant industry certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISM, COBIT, ITIL, or data/privacy\-focused certifications is preferred.
