description:
**Senior Functional Consultant ERPNext \| Frappe**

* **Role:** Functional Consultant
* **Industry Type:** IT Services \& Consulting
* **Department:** Consulting
* **Employment Type:** Full Time, Permanent
* **Role Category:** IT Consulting
* **Location:** Raipur/Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh

**About the Role**

Klaimify Private Limited is looking for an experienced and highly capable **Functional Consultant ERP Implementation** to join our growing ERP Consulting \& Implementation team at our Raipur office.

The role is intended for a professional who possesses strong hands\-on experience in **ERP implementations**, understands business processes deeply, can independently engage with clients, and is capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable and practical ERP solutions.

The ideal candidate should have strong functional expertise across ERP modules, excellent analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, and the ability to work across **multiple projects and client engagements simultaneously**.

Experience with **ERPNext and the Frappe Framework is highly desirable**.

This is **NOT** a conventional Business Analyst or ERP Support role. The position requires a consultant who can understand the underlying business problem, challenge inefficient processes, propose practical solutions, coordinate with technical teams and take functional ownership from **requirement discovery through implementation, UAT, go\-live and stabilization**.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. ERP Implementation \& Functional Consulting

* Drive and support **end\-to\-end ERP implementation projects** from requirement discovery through go\-live and post\-implementation support.
* Understand client business processes, organizational structures, operational workflows and business objectives.
* Conduct As\-Is and To\-Be process analysis and identify opportunities for process optimization.
* Translate business requirements into practical ERP solutions and configurations.
* Conduct functional gap analysis and recommend appropriate solutions with minimum unnecessary customization.
* Develop functional solution approaches aligned with ERP best practices and client business objectives.
* Understand dependencies between different ERP modules and ensure that proposed solutions work across the complete business process.
* Participate in implementation planning, configuration, testing, UAT, deployment and stabilization activities.

2\. Business Requirement Analysis \& Solution Design

* Conduct detailed requirement\-gathering workshops with business users and key stakeholders.
* Understand the actual business problem behind a stated requirement rather than simply documenting user requests.
* Analyze business processes and identify gaps, inefficiencies, redundancies and opportunities for automation.
* Convert business requirements into clear and actionable functional specifications.
* Prepare and maintain:
* Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
* Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS)
* User Stories
* Use Cases
* Process Flow Diagrams
* Gap Analysis Documents
* Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM)
* UAT Scenarios and Test Cases
* User Manuals and Process Documentation
* Ensure complete traceability between business requirements, functional solutions, development and testing.
* Work closely with technical teams to ensure that functional requirements are correctly understood and implemented.

3\. ERP Functional \& Module Expertise

* Develop strong functional understanding of ERP modules including:
* Finance \& Accounting
* Sales
* Purchase \& Procurement
* Inventory \& Warehouse
* Manufacturing
* CRM
* Projects
* HR \& Payroll
* Asset Management
* Other industry\-specific ERP modules
* Understand end\-to\-end business processes and their cross\-module dependencies.
* Analyze the impact of functional changes across connected modules and workflows.
* Identify whether a requirement should be addressed through configuration, process redesign, customization, integration or user training.
* Provide functional guidance to development and QA teams throughout implementation.

4\. Client Management \& Consulting

* Act as a trusted **functional consultant and business advisor** for assigned clients.
* Independently conduct client meetings, requirement workshops, process walkthroughs and solution discussions.
* Handle multiple stakeholders across multiple projects while maintaining strong communication and delivery discipline.
* Conduct functional demonstrations, solution walkthroughs and UAT sessions.
* Understand client concerns and provide practical, business\-oriented solutions.
* Manage functional escalations and client issues with ownership and professionalism.
* Build strong and sustainable client relationships through domain knowledge and solution\-oriented consulting.
* Communicate complex ERP concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

5\. Real\-Time Problem Resolution \& Out\-of\-the\-Box Thinking

* Demonstrate **excellent analytical and out\-of\-the\-box thinking** while solving business and ERP implementation challenges.
* Independently analyze and resolve functional issues arising during implementation, UAT and production support.
* Identify the root cause of functional problems rather than addressing only their symptoms.
* Evaluate alternative approaches when standard ERP functionality does not fully meet a business requirement.
* Recommend sustainable solutions instead of unnecessarily increasing system customization.
* Identify potential implementation risks and proactively address them.
* Work effectively under pressure during critical implementation, UAT and go\-live situations.

6\. UAT, Go\-Live \& Post\-Implementation Support

title: QA Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

The QA Manager will be responsible for overseeing and implementing Quality Assurance \& Food Safety Systems across the central bakery \& patisserie kitchen, warehouses and all company\-owned (COCO) outlets. The role involves close coordination with Production, Packing, Dispatch, Kitchen Stewarding, Maintenance, HR, Training, Procurement, and Receiving departments to ensure adherence to food safety, GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices), and GHP (Good Hygiene Practices). The QA Manager will also be responsible for the creation and implementation of the Food Safety Management System (FSMS) manual, including development of Critical Control Points (CCPs), SOPs, and quality audit frameworks and conduct periodic audits.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Quality Assurance \& Food Safety**

* Develop, implement, and maintain **FSMS Manual** in compliance with FSSAI, HACCP, ISO, and other statutory requirements.
* Establish and monitor **Critical Control Points (CCPs)** across production, packing, dispatch, and receiving operations.
* Ensure **GMP \& GHP standards** are implemented and followed across the factory and stores.
* Conduct routine quality checks of raw materials, in\-process products, and finished goods.

**2\. Audits \& Compliance**

* Plan and conduct **internal audits** for central kitchen and COCO stores.
* Coordinate **third\-party and regulatory audits** (FSSAI, HACCP, ISO, customer audits).
* Maintain all necessary documentation, traceability records, and compliance reports.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) in case of deviations.

**3\. Cross\-functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Production, Packing, Dispatch, Stewarding, and Maintenance teams to address quality and hygiene issues.
* Partner with HR \& Training to develop and deliver **food safety \& hygiene training programs** for all staff.
* Coordinate with Procurement \& Receiving for vendor audits, raw material quality checks, and specifications compliance.

**4\. SOPs \& Process Control**

* Draft, implement, and periodically review **SOPs for all operational areas** – production, handling, packaging, storage, dispatch, and outlet\-level practices.
* Monitor adherence to SOPs through inspections and feedback loops.
* Develop guidelines for pest control, sanitation, and cleaning protocols.

**5\. Continuous Improvement \& Reporting**

* Analyze quality trends, customer complaints, and wastage data to drive continuous improvement.
* Provide monthly reports on quality KPIs, audit findings, compliance status, and training effectiveness.
* Support management in decision\-making with data\-driven insights.

**Desired Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of **FSMS, HACCP, FSSAI, ISO 22000, GMP \& GHP**.
* Experience in quality assurance for bakery, patisserie, FMCG, or large\-scale food production units.
* Excellent documentation, audit, and compliance management skills.
* Strong leadership, training, and cross\-functional collaboration abilities.
* Analytical mindset with problem\-solving orientation.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s/master’s in food technology**, Food Science, Microbiology, or related field**.
* **8–12 years of QA experience** in food manufacturing/central kitchen, with at least **3–5 years in a managerial role**.
* Hands\-on experience in implementing HACCP/ISO systems and handling food safety audits.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Audit compliance scores (internal \& external).
* FSMS implementation effectiveness across units.
* CCP adherence and deviation closure rate.
* Number and quality of trainings conducted.
* Reduction in customer complaints and non\-conformities.
* Vendor compliance and raw material quality score.

**Job Summary**

The **Payroll \& Benefits Specialist** will be responsible for supporting accurate and timely payroll processing and benefits administration for employees in India. This role ensures compliance with applicable statutory requirements, internal policies, and payroll governance standards while delivering high\-quality employee experience. The position partners closely with HR, Finance, external vendors, and employees to manage payroll inputs, benefits operations, reporting, reconciliations, and issue resolution.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Payroll Administration**

* Support end\-to\-end payroll processing for employees in India in an accurate and timely manner.
* Validate payroll inputs including new hires, exits, promotions, transfers, salary revisions, variable pay, leave adjustments, reimbursements, and deductions.
* Review payroll data for completeness and accuracy prior to final submission.

* Respond to employee payroll queries and resolve discrepancies in a professional and timely manner.

**Benefits Administration**

* Administer employee benefits programs in India, including enrollment, changes, exits, and ongoing employee support.
* Coordinate with benefit providers \& internal teams to ensure smooth delivery of benefits programs.
* Support communication of benefits offerings, policies, and employee enrollment processes.
* Maintain accurate benefits records and ensure data integrity across HR and payroll systems.
* Assist in benefits billing validation, reconciliations, and reporting.
* Support annual benefits renewal activities and periodic program reviews.

**Compliance and Controls**

* Ensure payroll \& benefits processes comply with applicable laws, regulations, \& internal company policies
* Support statutory compliance activities related to payroll, including filings, deductions, and reporting.
* Assist with internal \& external audits by preparing documentation and responding to information requests.
* Identify process risks, control gaps, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee data and handle sensitive information with a high degree of integrity.

**Reporting and Process Improvement**

* Prepare regular and ad hoc payroll and benefits reports for HR, Finance, and management stakeholders.
* Analyze payroll and benefits data to identify trends, discrepancies, and improvement opportunities.
* Support system testing, process documentation, and implementation of payroll or benefits changes.
* Contribute to standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives across payroll and benefits operations.

**Qualifications**

* BBA in Human Resources from a reputed institute
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in payroll and benefits administration, preferably in a multinational or complex organization
* Experience managing payroll operations and employee benefits in India.
* Familiarity with payroll systems, HRIS platforms, MS Excel and related systems.
* Strong understanding of payroll processes, controls, and employee data management.
* Knowledge of India payroll statutory requirements and benefits practices.
* Experience supporting audits, reconciliations, and compliance reporting.
* Exposure to process improvement, standardization, or HR operations transformation initiatives.

**Key Skills, Competencies \& Behaviours**

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* High level of confidentiality and professional judgment, and acts with integrity.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Customer\-focused and continuous improvement mindset with a commitment to service excellence.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
* Drives accuracy, discipline, and accountability in execution.
* Collaborates effectively across teams and functions.
* Delivers a positive employee experience through responsive support.

**And More:**

We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:


* *Grow* : Be part of our global company with 20\+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.
* *Learn* : Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our Lean Academy, Coursera®, and online university.
* *Belong* : Experience an awesome place to work where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* *Give Back* : Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the \#1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!


***We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.***

Joining the Stanley Black \& Decker team means working in an innovative, tech\-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black \+ Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.


**Who We Are**

We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4\.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state\-of\-the\-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers \& greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.

**Diverse \& Inclusive Culture:**  

We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too.

description:
**First Response Executive (FRE) – Lead Response \& Qualification**

**Célèbre Aesthetics**

Job Post Summary

Company: Célèbre Aesthetics

Location: Gota, Ahmedabad

Job Type: Full\-time, On\-site

Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Industry: Premium Aesthetic Healthcare / Lead Response \& Patient Enquiry Coordination

Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹30,000 per month

Experience: Relevant experience preferred; strong freshers may also be considered.

Become the First Voice a Lead Experiences

At Célèbre Aesthetics, the first response to an enquiry can shape the entire patient journey that follows.

We are looking for a warm, confident, highly responsive and dependable First Response Executive (FRE) who can respond to new enquiries promptly, understand the lead’s requirement, ask the right initial questions and ensure that every genuine enquiry is handled professionally.

This is not simply a calling position. It is a first\-response and lead\-qualification role for someone who understands that speed, communication, accurate information and consistent follow\-up are essential to creating a strong first impression.

About Célèbre Aesthetics

Célèbre Aesthetics is a premium, specialised aesthetic surgery centre with a growing presence across Gujarat.

We offer planned aesthetic procedures including:

· Hair transplant

· Chest\-shaping surgery

· Nose reshaping

· Breast enlargement, reduction, lifting and shaping

· Fat\-removal and body\-contouring procedures

· Tummy shaping

· Intimate aesthetic procedures

· Other advanced aesthetic treatments performed by experienced plastic surgeons

Célèbre is a planned aesthetic healthcare environment rather than an emergency hospital. Our focus is to combine professional healthcare standards with a premium, comfortable and personalised patient experience.

About the Role

The First Response Executive will be the first point of contact for incoming leads and enquiries. The role is responsible for responding quickly, understanding the basic requirement of the lead, conducting the initial qualification and ensuring a smooth handover to the appropriate team.

The person in this role must be comfortable with a high\-response environment where new enquiries need to be addressed without unnecessary delay.

· Respond promptly to new leads and incoming enquiries.

· Return missed calls and messages at the earliest possible opportunity.

· Prioritise new enquiries and maintain timely initial and follow\-up communication.

· Understand the lead’s basic concern and requirement.

· Ask relevant qualification and screening questions during the call.

· Record accurate lead information and ensure proper handover to the concerned team.

· Coordinate with Medical Sales Counsellors, Patient Coordinators and other relevant teams.

· Maintain professional, warm and reassuring communication throughout the interaction.

Key Responsibilities1\. First Response to New Leads

· Respond to new leads quickly and professionally.

· Ensure no genuine enquiry is unnecessarily left unanswered.

· Return missed calls and messages at the earliest possible opportunity.

· Maintain a fast, prompt and consistent response to new leads.

2\. Lead Qualification \& Initial Screening

· Understand the reason for the enquiry.

· Ask relevant initial questions to understand the lead better.

· Capture basic details required for further coordination.

· Identify the lead’s requirement and readiness for further discussion.

· Ask questions clearly and naturally rather than making the conversation sound mechanical.

3\. Gynecomastia Lead Screening

· Understand the patient’s concern.

· Ask how long the concern has been present.

· Ask whether the patient has previously consulted a doctor or taken any treatment.

· Ask the area where the patient lives.

· Ask the patient’s age and occupation/work.

· Ask whether the patient does heavy lifting, gym or strenuous physical activity.

· Understand whether the patient is looking specifically for a surgical solution or wants to explore options.

· Ask about the patient’s expected consultation timeline.

· Check whether the patient is comfortable visiting Célèbre Aesthetics, Gota.

4\. Lead Handover \& Coordination

· Share relevant lead information accurately with the concerned team member.

· Coordinate with Medical Sales Counsellors and other concerned teams for the next step.

· Ensure that important information gathered during the first call is not lost during handover.

· Follow up internally when required so that the lead receives the appropriate next response.

5\. Follow\-Up

· Maintain timely follow\-up with leads as required.

· Respond to replies and callbacks promptly.

· Keep track of pending responses and follow\-ups.

· Do not allow leads to remain unattended because of delayed communication.

6\. Communication \& Information Handling

· Provide only approved and accurate information.

· Do not diagnose, make medical conclusions or promise treatment outcomes.

· Escalate medical or clinical questions to the appropriate authorised team member.

· Maintain professionalism and confidentiality while communicating with leads.

The Three Qualities We Value Most

**Character**  
Treat every lead, patient, family member and colleague with dignity, patience and respect. Maintain professionalism even when the interaction is challenging.

**Integrity**  
Communicate truthfully, share accurate information, protect confidentiality and never hide an important communication gap or mistake.

**Ownership**  
Do not simply pass a lead to somebody else. Understand what needs to happen, coordinate the appropriate person, follow up and ensure the lead reaches the right next step.

Who Will Succeed in This Role

· Very fast and responsive in replying to new leads and messages.

· Naturally warm, pleasant and confident on calls.

· Has a clear, professional and reassuring voice.

· Communicates comfortably in English, Hindi and Gujarati.

· Listens carefully and asks relevant questions.

· Can qualify leads without making the conversation feel like an interrogation.

· Is comfortable making calls and receiving incoming enquiries.

· Has strong follow\-up discipline.

· Can handle multiple leads and priorities simultaneously.

· Is organised and accurate while recording lead information.

· Takes ownership rather than waiting for repeated instructions.

· Remains calm and respectful with different types of callers.

· Is comfortable working in a target\- and response\-driven environment.

· Is professionally groomed and presentable.

· Learns quickly and accepts feedback positively.

Essential Requirements

· Graduate or diploma holder from a recognised institution.

· Fluent spoken English, Hindi and Gujarati.

· Ability to read and write professional English.

· Excellent telephone etiquette and verbal communication.

· Professional grooming and confident communication.

· Warm, pleasant and reassuring demeanour.

· Basic computer knowledge.

· Comfortable maintaining lead records and follow\-up information.

· Comfortable working full\-time and on\-site at Gota, Ahmedabad.

· Willingness to work Monday to Saturday.

· Relevant experience in lead handling, calling, customer service or healthcare is preferred.

Preferred Background

· Tele\-calling / lead generation

· Customer service

· Healthcare or clinic front office

· Patient coordination

· Hospitality

· Guest relations

· Aviation / cabin crew

· Premium customer service

· Sales support or inside sales

Previous experience is a plus, but speed of response, communication, maturity, ownership, listening ability and lead\-handling skills will matter strongly in the selection process.

Why Join Célèbre?

**Work in a Premium Aesthetic Healthcare Environment**  
Gain experience in a specialised aesthetic healthcare environment with a strong focus on patient experience.

**Build Lead\-Handling Expertise**  
Develop practical skills in first response, qualification, communication, follow\-up and internal coordination.

**Learn the Aesthetic Healthcare Journey**  
Understand how an enquiry moves from the first response towards counselling, consultation and further patient coordination.

**Responsibility, Not Just Calling**  
The role requires ownership of the quality and speed of the first response, not merely completing calls.

**Long\-Term Career Growth**  
A capable performer may grow into senior lead\-handling, counselling, patient coordination or centre\-coordination responsibilities. Growth will depend on capability, character, ownership, judgement and results.

Working Details

· Location: Gota, Ahmedabad

JOB DESCRIPTION — COMMIS CHEFStarbrews Coffee Shop

**Location:** TCI Chowk, Rourkela, Odisha  
**Department:** Kitchen

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About Starbrews

Starbrews Coffee Shop is a modern café focused on **fresh brews, cozy vibes \& quick bites**, serving quality coffee, snacks, continental food and bakery products. We are building a professional café operation with strong focus on **consistency, hygiene, speed and customer experience**.

Position Overview

We are looking for a **Commis Chef** to support the Head Chef in the day\-to\-day kitchen operations. The candidate will be responsible for **food preparation, cooking assistance, mise en place, hygiene, portion control and maintaining kitchen standards**.

The ideal candidate should be hardworking, disciplined, quick to learn and comfortable working in a fast\-paced café environment.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Food Preparation**

* Assist the Head Chef in preparing continental dishes, snacks, sandwiches, burgers, pasta, fries and other café items.
* Complete daily **mise en place** before service.
* Wash, cut, portion and prepare ingredients as per SOPs.
* Follow standardized recipes and portion sizes.
* Ensure food is prepared fresh and consistently.

**2\. Kitchen Operations**

* Assist the Head Chef during peak service hours.
* Ensure orders are prepared within the required service time.
* Maintain an organized and efficient workstation.
* Coordinate with the barista and service team for smooth order flow.
* Inform the Head Chef/Manager immediately about any shortage of ingredients or kitchen issues.

**3\. Hygiene \& Food Safety**

* Maintain high standards of personal and kitchen hygiene.
* Follow proper cleaning and sanitization procedures.
* Prevent cross\-contamination during food preparation.
* Ensure raw and cooked food are stored separately.
* Follow **FIFO (First In, First Out)** principles.
* Check food quality, freshness and expiry dates.

**4\. Inventory \& Wastage**

* Handle ingredients carefully and minimize wastage.
* Inform the Head Chef about low\-stock or damaged items.
* Follow correct storage procedures.
* Help with daily stock checking when required.
* Ensure ingredients are properly labelled and stored.

**5\. Closing Duties**

* Clean and sanitize the workstation after service.
* Properly store leftover ingredients.
* Clean kitchen equipment and utensils.
* Ensure gas, electrical equipment and kitchen appliances are safely switched off as per closing SOP.
* Leave the kitchen ready for the next day's operations.

Skills Required

* Basic knowledge of cooking and food preparation.
* Understanding of kitchen hygiene and food safety.
* Ability to follow recipes and SOPs accurately.
* Good knife\-handling and preparation skills.
* Ability to work quickly during busy hours.
* Team player with good communication skills.
* Willingness to learn new recipes and café operations.
* Punctual, disciplined and responsible.

Experience

**Preferred:** 1–2 years of experience in a café, restaurant, hotel or QSR kitchen.

**Freshers:** Candidates with basic cooking knowledge and a strong willingness to learn may also be considered.

Working Conditions

* Full\-time café kitchen role.
* Flexible working hours depending on café operations.
* Must be comfortable working during weekends and holidays.
* Work involves standing for extended periods and working in a busy kitchen environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Commis Chef will be evaluated on:

* **Food quality \& consistency**
* **Preparation speed**
* **Hygiene and cleanliness**
* **Recipe \& portion adherence**
* **Food wastage control**
* **Mise en place readiness**
* **Team coordination**
* **Punctuality \& discipline**
* **Following kitchen SOPs**

Salary

**₹12,000–₹16,000 per month**, depending on experience and skill level.

Career Growth

A successful Commis Chef can progress to:

**Commis Chef → Demi Chef de Partie → Chef de Partie → Senior Chef / Kitchen Supervisor**

What We Expect From You

At Starbrews, the Commis Chef is not just a cooking assistant. You are expected to **take ownership of your station, maintain cleanliness, follow recipes, work with urgency and continuously improve your skills.**

**“Good food starts with a disciplined kitchen.”**

 JOB PURPOSE \& SPECIFICRESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





**INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS \& EMPLOYEE RELATIONS** 



* Develop and maintain cordial, harmonious, and constructive industrial relations within the organization.

* Graduate with PG Diploma in Personnel Management and IR / Degree in Law / MSW/ Post Graduate degree in Business Management (PGDBM) with specialization in HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT.



  





**RELEVANT EXPERIENCE** 



* Minimum 5 years of experience in Human Resources and Industrial Relations functions.
* Proven experience in handling employee relations, union interactions, collective bargaining, and labour law compliance.
* Experience in representing organizations before Labour Authorities, Labour Courts, Industrial Tribunals, and other statutory forums.
* Exposure to disciplinary proceedings, domestic inquiries, and labour litigation management.

 Sauce Labs is the world’s largest full\-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind Selenium. Trusted by 80% of the world’s top ten largest financial institutions and over 300,000 enterprise users, Sauce Labs provides the only AI platform capable of turning business intent into autonomous testing and quality assurance. With a proprietary dataset of 8\.7 billion test runs, Sauce Labs empowers the Fortune 2000 to bridge the gap between AI\-driven code generation and enterprise\-grade software quality. Learn more at http://saucelabs.com.
   

  

**Release Assurance at the Speed of AI \|** 
**Meet the new Sauce Labs**
 The Role
   

  

 We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented HR Ops Manager to drive operational excellence and manage core employee lifecycle processes in our India office. In this role, you will be responsible for end\-to\-end Onboarding and Off\-boarding, leading the Internal Committee for PoSH compliance, ensuring Indian statutory compliance, and supporting HRBP activities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Onboarding \& Offboarding Lifecycle
* Onboarding: Own the entire new\-hire experience from offer acceptance to day 30/60/90 integration \- ensuring document verification, background checks (BGV), system access, and orientation.
* Offboarding: Manage seamless exit processes, including resignation handling, exit interviews, asset clearance coordination, full \& final (F\&F) settlement coordination, and exit analytics.
* Continuously refine onboarding and offboarding workflows to improve candidate experience and operational efficiency.
* PoSH Committee Management \& Employee Relations
* Serve as the primary lead/Presiding Officer/member for the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (PoSH) Internal Committee (IC).
* Ensure 100% compliance with the Indian PoSH Act, including organizing mandatory awareness sessions, annual filing, and managing IC meetings.
* Handle sensitive employee relations issues, grievances, and formal investigations with complete discretion, empathy, and adherence to legal protocols.
* Support and advise local middle managers on employee relations, performance issues, and team dynamics.
* HR Operations \& Indian Statutory Compliance
* Oversee HR operational processes for India, ensuring compliance with local labor laws, Shop \& Establishment Act, PF, ESIC, LWF, and Gratuity.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems, and audit\-ready compliance documentation.
* Partner with Finance/Payroll teams to ensure accurate inputs for monthly payroll processing and exit settlements.


**Required Skills**
* Experience: 5 \- 8 years of progressive HR experience, with a solid mix of HR Operations and statutory compliance.
* PoSH Expertise: Proven experience leading or actively participating in a PoSH Internal Committee (IC) and managing formal workplace investigations.
* Employee Lifecycle: Strong hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end Onboarding, Offboarding, and HR operations in India.
* Tech\-Savvy: Experience working with modern HRIS, performance tools (e.g., Lattice, BambooHR, Workday), and grievance platforms.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with high emotional intelligence and discretion.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Formal certification as a PoSH Enabler / IC Member.
* Experience working in global, distributed, or fast\-paced technology/startup environments.
* Demonstrated ability to coach and advise middle managers on employee relations, performance issues, and team dynamics.


 Please note our Privacy Policy for Applicants when applying for a job at Sauce Labs.
   

  

 Sauce Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employee and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity/expression/status, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status.
   

  

 Security responsibilities at Sauce
   

  

 At Sauce, we will commit to supporting the health and safety of employees and properties, partnering with internal stakeholders to learn and act on ever\-evolving security protocols and procedures. You’ll be expected to fully comply with all policies and procedures related to security at the department and org wide level and exercise a ‘security first’ approach to how we design, build \& run our products and services.

title: Deputy Manager - MIS
description:
Job Description
**JOB DESCRIPTION**


**MIS****– International Business \& Global Reporting**


**Function**  

Finance \& Accounts  

  

**Reports to**  

CFO – Garment Business  

  

**Location**  

Mysore Road, Bangalore  

  

**Team managed**  

Individual contributor  

  

**Employment type**  

Full\-time
  

**Role purpose**


Responsible for consolidating, validating, and standardizing data across international factories and buyer programs into a single, reliable reporting layer. The role sits between factory\-level MIS submissions and the FP\&A / leadership reporting cadence, ensuring that order, cost, and production data flowing in from multiple overseas factories is accurate, timely, and presented in a consistent format for decision\-making.


This is a build\-phase, execution\-focused role: the person will help set up recurring MIS templates and reporting cadences from scratch, working closely with the FP\&A Lead/Analyst, Merchandising, and factory\-level teams, in a multi\-factory (CMT/FOB) international manufacturing environment.


**Key responsibilities**


**MIS and data consolidation**


* Collect, consolidate, and validate MIS submissions from multiple international factories (production, order status, cost, and shipment data).
* Maintain standardized MIS templates and ensure factories report on a consistent format and cadence.
* Reconcile factory\-level data against central records maintained by the Virtual Manufacturing Office and flag discrepancies for follow\-up.
* Build and maintain trackers for order\-wise, factory\-wise, and buyer\-wise status across the international business.
**Global and management reporting**


* Prepare recurring dashboards and reports (weekly/monthly) covering order pipeline, capacity utilization, and factory performance for the FP\&A Lead and Head of Department.
* Support the FP\&A team with data inputs for budget vs. actual and variance reporting.
* Assist in preparing management presentations and business review decks with accurate, up\-to\-date data.
* Track key international business metrics (lead times, on\-time shipment, order fulfilment) and highlight exceptions.
**Coordination and follow\-up**


* Liaise with factory\-based teams to chase pending data and close reporting gaps.
* Coordinate with Merchandising, Quality, and Compliance teams to ensure MIS reflects the latest order and compliance status.
* Support the Logistics Extension Executive and Export \& Trade Compliance Executive with shipment and documentation data as needed for reporting.
**Systems and process**


* Work within the ERP/costing/MIS tools to extract, clean, and organize data for reporting.
* Support continuous improvement of reporting templates, automation of recurring reports, and reduction of manual data\-chasing.
* Maintain a clean, well\-documented data trail for audit and review purposes.
**Candidate profile**


**Experience**


* Fresher or 1–2 years of experience; prior exposure to MIS, reporting, or business analyst roles is a plus but not mandatory.
**S****kills**


* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, dashboards); working knowledge of PowerPoint for reporting decks.
* Comfortable working with large, fragmented datasets from multiple sources and consolidating them accurately.
* High attention to detail and ownership of data accuracy and timeliness.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to coordinate with factory teams and internal stakeholders across functions.
* Proactive follow\-up skills – comfortable chasing data from multiple factories/teams to meet reporting deadlines.
**Qual****ification**


* MBA (Finance)

title: Associate - Founder's Office
description:
**THE ROLE IN ONE LINE** 




 You get dropped into a team that has a number which is not moving. You use AI to move it. Six weeks. Then you rotate to the next one.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 



* Embed with one function for six weeks: sales operations, marketing measurement, cost and efficiency, or delivery. One named sponsor, one signed outcome.
* Spend week one watching the real work. Sit on demo calls. Sit beside an Account Director for a full call block. Pull the data yourself. You will not diagnose a business from a dashboard.
* Build the thing that fixes it. An agent, a workflow, a scoring model, an automation that removes fifteen hours a week. You build it, not a vendor and not the engineering team.
* Get it adopted. Sit next to the people using it until they use it without you in the room.
* Hand it over with a named owner and a runbook, then write a one\-page memo carrying a rupee number that your sponsor and Finance both sign.
* Rotate. Roughly six of these a year.



  





**WHAT YOU WILL HAVE DONE BY YEAR ONE** 



* Day 30: one automation live that removes 10 or more hours a week of manual work.
* Day 90: two functions worked, ₹40 lakh of annualised, counter\-signed impact.
* Month 12: six projects shipped, verified impact of at least six times your cost, and function heads asking for you by name.



  





**WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 



* An engineering degree from a Tier 1 institute, 0 to 2 years out.
* Ex\-product, ex\-consulting, or someone who has run an AI\-led initiative end to end. Any of the three works.
* Something you have shipped with AI that another person used repeatedly. Not drafts and summaries. A workflow, an agent, a scoring model, an internal tool. Send the link; we will ask you to walk us through the decisions you made building it.
* SQL and spreadsheets at working fluency. You get your own data. You do not raise a ticket to answer a question.
* Clear, short writing. The one\-page memo is the actual product of this job.
* Comfort with being the most junior person in the room, telling a function head that their process is the problem, and being welcome there afterwards.



  





**DO NOT APPLY IF** 



* Your AI experience is prompting a chatbot for drafts and summaries.
* You need a fully specified brief before you can start.
* You want to work on strategy without pulling data or shipping anything.
* You cannot name a specific number you moved and explain how it was measured.



  





***HOW TO APPLY***




 Send a link to something you have built, along with your CV. Applications without a link will not be reviewed.

**About Doto Health (Care Mother)** 




  





 Doto Health Private Limited, operating as CareMother, is a Pune\-based, Made\-in\-India femtech and medical\-device company on a mission to create equal opportunities of care for women. We build a full\-stack, AI\-enabled maternal\-care platform — spanning conception to post\-partum — that combines smart monitoring devices, AI\-powered decision support and protocol\-driven workflows for fetal, labour, birthing and post\-partum care.
 



 Our flagship products include AnandiMaa (antenatal care platform), FetoMax (wireless NST/CTG fetal monitor) and Nurtura (intrapartum and post\-partum AI co\-pilot). CareMother is already deployed across 28 states and 2,500\+ facilities in India and seven LMICs, covering 700,000\+ pregnancies and 2 million\+ tests, and is a licensed CDSCO medical device backed by clinical research partnerships with IIT Bombay, the University of Oxford and Mayo Clinic.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 The Founder's Office is the engine room of the company — where strategy, data and execution meet. As Business Analyst \& Fundraising Associate, you will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the Founder \& CEO to turn ambiguous problems into structured analysis, decisions and outcomes. Roughly half of your time will be spent on business analysis and strategy, and half on driving our fundraising — an active Pre\-Series A equity round alongside impact and grant funding. It is a rare front\-row seat to how a mission\-driven healthtech company scales, and a launchpad for a career in strategy, investing or entrepreneurship.
 



  





**What You'll Do**

title: AI Engineer
description:
Company Overview
   

 Jetbro is a technology partner for enterprises where reliability is non\-negotiable. We build and integrate mission\-critical systems across technology consulting, engineering, data, cloud, and AI. Our operating principle is Function over flash. Always. We favour practical, resilient engineering and solutions designed for long\-term clarity, scale, and business impact.
   

  

 The selected candidate will be employed by Safal Softcom (Jetbro's Partner company) and work on\-site from Safal Softcom’s premises, embedded within its product team. SAFAL is an AI\-powered Source\-to\-Pay platform for industrial enterprises, supporting complex, high\-volume, business\-critical procurement operations across areas including sourcing, supplier management, contracts, purchasing, invoicing, and spend intelligence.
   

 About the Role
   

 We are seeking an AI Engineer with 1–3 years of experience to join a 20\-person B2B product team. In this full\-time, on\-site role, you will help develop and productionise intelligent features for enterprise procurement workflows. Your work will support practical use cases including supplier scoring, spend analytics, forecasting, recommendations, document intelligence, anomaly detection, and workflow automation.
   

  

 You will bridge research and engineering: evaluating suitable AI/ML techniques, training and fine\-tuning models, and integrating dependable AI services into the product. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, frontend engineers, product managers, and domain specialists to ensure each solution is accurate, scalable, explainable, and valuable to users.
   

 Key Responsibilities
   

* Research and evaluate AI/ML techniques relevant to procurement workflows, including forecasting, recommendations, document intelligence, and anomaly detection.
* Develop, train, evaluate, and fine\-tune models for use cases such as supplier scoring, spend analytics, and anomaly detection.
* Prepare high\-quality datasets for training and testing through cleaning, structuring, validation, and feature engineering.
* Build and integrate AI services into the product in collaboration with backend and frontend engineering teams.
* Translate product requirements and domain needs into well\-defined experiments, technical approaches, and measurable model objectives.
* Conduct experiments, benchmark models against suitable baselines, and communicate findings to support evidence\-based decisions.
* Optimise deployed models for accuracy, latency, reliability, scalability, and operational performance.
* Explore and implement agentic AI workflows that automate multi\-step procurement tasks and support informed decision\-making.
* Develop APIs or services that expose model capabilities reliably and securely to other parts of the platform.
* Monitor model and data performance after deployment, investigate degradation, and implement appropriate improvements.
* Maintain clear documentation for research, datasets, experiments, model behaviour, evaluation results, and implementations.
* Participate in code reviews, contribute to high engineering standards, and improve the reproducibility and maintainability of AI systems.


 Requirements
   

  

 Mandatory Requirements
   

* 2–4 years of professional experience in AI engineering, machine learning, data science, or a closely related role.
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience with ML libraries such as scikit\-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, or comparable tools.
* Sound understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, overfitting, validation, and evaluation metrics.
* Experience preparing and analysing data with pandas, NumPy, or similar libraries.
* Familiarity with model\-training workflows, hyperparameter tuning, cross\-validation, and experiment tracking.
* Ability to prepare reliable training and test datasets, including data cleaning, structuring, validation, and quality checks.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying and analysing data.
* Foundational understanding of model deployment, inference, API integration, and production performance considerations.
* Experience using Git and working effectively within collaborative software\-development workflows.
* Ability to write clean, maintainable, well\-documented, and testable code.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to investigate complex data or model issues.
* Full\-time availability and willingness to work on\-site from Safal Softcom’s premises as an embedded member of the product team.


 What we care about
   

* Function over flash. We value straightforward, well\-reasoned solutions that solve real problems over unnecessary complexity or novelty.
* Reliability and reproducibility. Models must be well tested, documented, traceable, and dependable in production.
* Ownership. You will take responsibility for the quality and lifecycle of your work, from research and implementation to deployment and improvement.
* Business impact. We prioritise AI features that create measurable value for enterprise users and improve real procurement decisions or processes.
* Collaboration. Clear communication and productive teamwork across product, engineering, and domain teams are essential.
* Learning mindset. AI evolves quickly; we value people who remain curious, learn from experiments, and apply new knowledge thoughtfully.
* Scalability. You will consider data quality, cost, latency, model serving, and long\-term maintenance from the beginning.


 About You
   

 You are an early\-career AI engineer with a strong grounding in machine learning and an interest in applying it to complex, real\-world business problems. You enjoy moving between data, experiments, code, and product requirements, and you care as much about production usefulness as model performance.
   

  

 You take a pragmatic approach to problem\-solving. You understand that a model is only valuable when it can be deployed, monitored, understood by stakeholders, and maintained over time. You can balance accuracy, simplicity, explainability, and operational constraints without losing sight of the user and the business outcome.
   

  

 You communicate clearly, welcome feedback, and enjoy working closely with engineers and non\-technical colleagues. You are comfortable working through ambiguity, breaking large problems into manageable experiments, and building dependable systems within a collaborative product team.
   

  

  

  

 Benefits
   

  

 Growth at Jetbro
   


 If you do well, this role can grow into:
   




* Senior Backend Engineer
* Platform / Infrastructure Engineer
* System Architect (longer term)


 We invest heavily in people who invest in learning.

title: Data Scientist II
description:
**Job Description**
 Role: Data scientist II
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We’re MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we’re all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better.
   

  

 As a Data scientist II in our data science department, you’ll have the chance to:
   

  

* Own and execute end\-to\-end data science projects.
* Translate product requirements into analytical requirements and specifications, designing and developing the required functionality within the internal tool.
* Leverage technology to automate daily operational activities.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to activate media campaigns based on analytical outputs.
* Ensure actionable insights are delivered by utilizing all our rich data in conjunction with client specific data.


**Who are your stakeholders?**
* Account managers, traders, sales and analysts: you’ll build solutions that are used primarily by internal customers through our proprietary platforms like Lab and Hub. Usually, the requirements and any feedback will go through our project management team.
* Product management: you’ll build solutions as part of the product roadmaps, and these will be used by advertisers and agencies. Any feedback will come through our client\-facing product management team.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience of working on data science projects (for a minimum of three years).
* Experience in applying machine learning, statistical pattern recognition, and data mining algorithms to prediction problems.
* Experience of at least one programming language (Java, Python, R)
* Experience with advanced SQL and good experience in big data ecosystems (Hive/Pig/MapReduce, Spark).
* Great attention to detail, along with an ability to meet deadlines and prioritize your workload.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* A passion for keeping up with latest technologies and applying them in relevant products.
* A determined sense of purpose that helps you achieve stretch goals.
* A can\-do attitude, with a dream to grow alongside us.


 We’ve highlighted some key skills, experience and requirements for this role. But please don’t worry if you don’t meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They might see something in your background that’s a fit for this role, or another opportunity at MiQ.
   

  

 If you have a passion for the role, please still apply.
   

  

**What impact will you create?**
 Everything you do will help us lead the programmatic industry and make it better. Your passion for cutting\-edge techniques and technologies means you’ll build incredible solutions that are able to scale. Plus, you’ll get involved in innovation and research, representing MiQ through thought leadership and at industry events. All your work and efforts will help our teams find valuable insights, optimize campaigns, and measure success.
   

  

**What’s in it for you?**
 Our Center of Excellence is the very heart of MiQ, and it’s where the magic happens. It means everything you do and everything you create will have a huge impact across our entire global business.
   

  

 MiQ is incredibly proud to foster a welcoming culture. We do everything possible to make sure everyone feels valued for what they bring. With global teams committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we’re always moving towards becoming an even better place to work.
   

  

**Values**
 Our values are so much more than statements
 **.** 
 They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone, so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do \- no matter how big or small.
   

  

* We do what we love \- Passion
* We figure it out \- Determination
* We anticipate the unexpected \- Agility
* We always unite \- Unite
* We dare to be unconventional \- Courage


**Benefits**
 Every region and office have specific perks and benefits, but every person joining MiQ can expect:
   

  

* A hybrid work environment
* New hire orientation with job specific onboarding and training
* Internal and global mobility opportunities
* Competitive healthcare benefits
* Bonus and performance incentives
* Generous annual PTO paid parental leave, with two additional paid days to acknowledge holidays, cultural events, or inclusion initiatives.
* Employee resource groups designed to connect people across all MiQ regions, drive action, and support our communities.


*Apply today!*
*Equal Opportunity Employer*

**Required qualifications**

 (MongoDB, Express, React, Node).

**Nice to have**

**Soft skills** 



* Product\-first curiosity — you want to understand the customer and the problem, not just the tech.
* Strong ownership — you create the work and drive it end to end; you don't wait to be assigned it.
* Self\-directed builder — comfort with ambiguity, fast iteration, and wearing several hats. A cog\-in\-the\-wheel mindset won't thrive here.

title: Power Platform Developer
description:
Junior Power Platform Developer

**Experience:** Fresher – 1 Year  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated **Junior Power Platform Developer** to join our team and grow their career in Microsoft Power Platform development.

This opportunity is suitable for **fresh graduates or candidates with up to 1 year of experience in software development or related technologies**.

Previous experience with Microsoft Power Platform is preferred but **not mandatory**. If you have a good foundation in programming, strong problem\-solving skills, and an interest in learning new technologies, we would like to hear from you.

You will receive the opportunity to work on real\-world business applications and automation solutions using **Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and other Microsoft technologies**.

What You'll Be Doing

* Develop business applications using **Microsoft Power Apps**.
* Build workflow automation using **Power Automate**.
* Work with **SharePoint, Dataverse, and Microsoft 365**.
* Understand business requirements and convert them into technical solutions.
* Create forms, screens, validations, workflows, and approval processes.
* Integrate applications with different data sources and systems.
* Test applications and troubleshoot issues.
* Fix bugs and enhance existing applications and automations.
* Participate in application deployment and production support.
* Prepare basic technical documentation.
* Learn and follow development, security, and coding best practices.
* Work with senior team members on enterprise Power Platform projects.

Essential Skills

We are looking for candidates with a good foundation in technology rather than extensive Power Platform experience.

* Basic understanding of **programming concepts and application development**.
* Knowledge or experience in at least one technology such as **C\#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, Python, SQL, HTML/CSS, or similar**.
* Good understanding of databases and basic data concepts.
* Strong logical thinking and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability and willingness to learn new technologies.
* Good communication skills.
* Ability to understand requirements and work as part of a development team.

Nice to Have

Any exposure to the following will be an advantage:

* Microsoft **Power Apps**
* Microsoft **Power Automate**
* Microsoft **Dataverse**
* **SharePoint Online**
* Microsoft 365
* Power BI
* Power Pages
* SQL
* REST APIs / JSON
* Azure
* Git / GitHub / Azure DevOps
* Microsoft Power Platform certifications or training

**Power Platform experience is an advantage, but not a requirement. Candidates with a strong development aptitude and willingness to learn Power Platform are encouraged to apply.**

Who Can Apply?

We welcome applications from:

* **Fresh graduates**
* Candidates with **6 months to 1 year of IT/software development experience**
* Junior developers looking to move into Microsoft Power Platform
* Candidates who have completed Power Platform courses, certifications, internships, or personal projects
* Developers from other technologies who are interested in building a career in the Microsoft ecosystem

Education

Bachelor's degree or diploma in:

* Computer Science
* Information Technology
* Software Engineering
* Computer Applications
* Electronics / Engineering with programming exposure
* Or another relevant technical qualification

Fresh graduates with strong technical and problem\-solving skills are encouraged to apply.

What We're Looking For

More than extensive experience, we value candidates who are:

* **Eager to learn**
* Curious about technology
* Good at logical problem\-solving
* Comfortable learning independently
* Able to communicate clearly
* Willing to take ownership of assigned tasks
* Interested in building business applications and automation solutions
* Looking to build a long\-term career in the **Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem**

Screening Requirements

When applying, please include:

* Your educational qualification and year of graduation.
* Your total IT/software development experience, if any.
* Technologies you have worked with.
* Any experience or training in **Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint, Dataverse, or Power BI**.
* Details or links to any academic, personal, internship, or professional projects you have developed.
* Any relevant Microsoft or programming certifications.

**Freshers are welcome to apply. Power Platform experience is preferred but not mandatory.**

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

description:
**About Neo** 




  





 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia**
 — Co\-Founder of
 
 Zeta
 
 ,
 
 Radix
 
 , and
 
 Titan
 
 —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 



  




* **Tasket** 
 — A radically reimagined, AI\-native, work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* **Friday** 
 — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* **Studio** 
 — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* **Scribe** 
 — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the role** 




  





 As a QA Engineer II you will own test strategy and automation for the features you work on, partnering closely with developers and product to keep quality high as we ship fast.
 



 We are proponents of leveraging best\-in\-breed AI tools at every step of the engineering lifecycle — design, development, review, and testing. This requires a different engineering mindset: a lean team of senior, hands\-on, AI\-adept engineers, resulting in ultra\-rapid iteration cycles and fast output. You will work within this approach, from design through to production.
 



 This is a step up from an entry\-level QA role: you're expected to design test strategy independently and build automation others can rely on, without yet owning the standards for a whole team.
 



  





**Job Location** 




  





 Bangalore, India (100% on\-site)
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**Test strategy \& design** 



* Design test plans and test cases for the features you work on, in partnership with the developers and PMs building them.
* Validate quality across web, API, and mobile surfaces, catching gaps before they reach production.



**Automation development** 



* Build and extend automated test solutions across web, API, and mobile using tools like RestAssured, Apache HttpClient, Unirest, OkHttp, and Appium.
* Apply solid framework design (Factory, Builder patterns) so automation stays maintainable and extensible as coverage grows.



**Shift\-left \& quality gates** 



* Contribute quality input across design, development, deployment, and post\-release — not just at the test\-execution stage.
* Help define the quality gates a code change must pass, and flag issues early enough to fix cheaply.



**Performance \& metrics** 



* Run performance tests using tools like Apache JMeter and set up the environments they need.
* Track quality metrics for your area, spot trends, and raise issues before they become incidents.



**Agent leverage \& collaboration** 



* Use AI coding assistants to speed up test creation, script maintenance, and debugging.
* Work within Agile ceremonies, log defects and coverage clearly in tools like Jira and TestRail, and communicate testing status to developers and PMs.



  





**Skills** 




  




* **AI\-native engineering practice** 
 — Uses AI coding assistants fluently to accelerate test script creation, maintenance, and root\-cause analysis during debugging.
* **API \& automation** 
 — Hands\-on experience building automated tests with RestAssured, Apache HttpClient, Unirest, or OkHttp, and mobile automation with Appium.
* **Framework design** 
 — Comfortable applying design patterns (Factory, Builder) to keep automation frameworks maintainable and extensible across web, API, and mobile.
* **Performance testing** 
 — Practical experience with Apache JMeter, including setting up and tuning the test environment.
* **Tooling** 
 — Working knowledge of TestRail for test management, Jira or Redmine for defect tracking, an IDE (IntelliJ, Eclipse, Visual Studio, or Xcode), and log analysis with Kibana, New Relic, or similar.
* **Testing depth** 
 — Comfortable going beyond black\-box testing — understands software internals well enough to debug issues, and applies white\-box testing and TDD where it fits.
* **Agile collaboration** 
 — Works effectively within Agile teams, contributing to test strategy, planning, design, and execution across the product lifecycle.



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 




  




* 3\-5 years of experience as a QA Engineer.
* BTech in Computer Science or equivalent technical field.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with hands\-on automation experience across API, web, and mobile testing.



  





**Equal Opportunity** 




  





 Neo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

The strength of our team is every bit as important as our cutting\-edge technology and we invest in clear compensation and comprehensive benefits for our employees. People for us, are not resources, but our capital.
 



  





 If you are a talented professional, an out\-of\-the\-box thinker with a zeal to help change, and passionate about healthcare, we invite you to join us and be a part of a historic initiative in India.
 



 Interested in being a part of the next revolution in cancer treatment? Send your resume to
 **careers@immuneel.com** 




  





**1\. Role Title:** 




 Trainee – Quality Assurance (Manufacturing Quality Assurance)
 



  





**2\. Department/Function:** 




 Quality Assurance
 



  





**3\. Reporting Structure:** 



* **Reports to:** 
 Associate Director\- Quality Assurance
* **Direct Reports:** 
 Nil



  





**4\. Role Summary:** 




 The Trainee Quality Assurance (Manufacturing Quality Assurance) is responsible for providing in\-process quality oversight and supporting batch release activities to ensure compliance with cGMP and regulatory requirements. This role interfaces closely with Manufacturing, Quality Control, Facilities \& Operations, Environmental Health \& Safety (EHS), Regulatory Affairs, and internal QA teams to support QA operational requirements. The analyst ensures adherence to approved procedures, monitors manufacturing activities, reviews and approves GMP documentation, and supports investigations, deviations, and corrective actions to maintain product quality and compliance throughout the manufacturing lifecycle
 **.** 




  





**5\. Key Responsibilities:** 



1. Perform In\-Process Quality Assurance (IPQA) activities including dispensing verification, area clearance, line clearance, and material reconciliation in compliance with cGMP requirements.
2. Review and approve manufacturing batch records (MBRs) and support release of Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP) batches for clinical and commercial use.
3. Review batch packing records (BPRs) and ensure timely release of clinical and commercial batches in accordance with approved specifications and regulatory commitments.
4. Assist in preparing, reviewing, and supporting approval of Annual Product Quality Review (APQR) reports in line with regulatory and internal quality system requirements.
5. Execute Process Validation and Cleaning Validation protocols and reports, including deviation management and closure.
6. Assist in developing and implementing qualification strategies for existing and new equipment in alignment with validation master plans and risk\-based approaches.
7. Assist in preparing, reviewing, and maintaining apex quality documents such as the Site Master File (SMF), Validation Master Plan (VMP), and Quality Manual.
8. Preparation of User Requirement Specifications (URS) and execution of IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols and reports for equipment, utilities, and systems.
9. Support the Document Control and Document Management System, including issuance, revision, archival, and retrieval of GMP documents.
10. Initiate and review Quality Management System (QMS) documents, including SOPs, policies, and procedures related to manufacturing and quality operations.
11. Prepare and review quality system documentation, including qualification and validation protocols, SOPs, study protocols, qualification summary reports, risk assessments, and deviation/failure investigation reports.
12. Participate in internal audits, periodic system reviews, and regulatory inspections, and support implementation of continuous improvement initiatives for quality systems, processes, and workflows.



  





**6\. Primary Objectives:** 



1. In\-process manufacturing compliance ofthe clinical and commercial batches
2. Participation in the QMS\-related activities, Deviation, change control, OOS, investigation, risk assessment
3. To access and support in the implementation and qualification of digital platforms for QMS, LMS, TMS and DMS



  





**7\. Competencies Required:** 




  




* **Technical Competencies:**


1. Thorough understanding of IPQA and batch release activity
2. Knowledge in the sterile manufacturing, GMP, GLP and GDP of various regulated (FDA, EMA) and domestic markets.
3. Through understanding of Qualification/validation procedures
4. Thorough understanding of Deviation, Change Control, investigation, root cause analysis and CAPA
5. Knowledge of data integrity, audit trails, ICH, and other regulatory guidelines.
6. Exposure to work in a Digital QMS environment, i.e. Electronic systems – ELN (Electronic lab notebook), ICS (Instrument calibration system), EQS (Equipment Qualification system), IMS (Inventory management system), LMS (Learning Management system), QMS (Quality management system), DMS (Document management system).



  




* **Soft Skills:**


1. **Interpersonal SkillsAdaptable:** 
 Capable of adapting to others and new situations; flexible; can handle multiple tasks
2. **Team player:** 
 Works well with a diverse or multi\-disciplinary group to achieve a common goal
3. **Assertive:** 
 Confident or insistent in stating opinions or claiming rights without infringing on others.
4. **Quality commitment** 
 : Has a consistent attitude and respect for high\-quality standards.
5. **Organized:** 
 Arranges work in an orderly way; has an orderly state of mind
6. **Persistent:** 
 Refuses to give up, especially when faced with opposition or difficulty; continues firmly or steadily
7. **Quick Study:** 
 Can master a Situation or learn new things faster than contemporaries
8. **Judgment:** 
 Able to formulate opinions, compare and decide, has good sense
9. **Enthusiastic:** 
 Has an intense or eager interest in something; is ardent and positive in response
10. **Committed:** 
 Pledges oneself to a course of action and is willing to sacrifice to make it happen
11. **Continuous learner:** 
 unusual desire to learn continuously, develop oneself and keep current



  





**8\. Qualifications:** 



* Educational Qualification – B. Tech, M. Tech. B. Pharma, M. Pharm, M.Sc., in biotechnology/biopharmaceutical technology /biological sciences/quality assurance with relevant experience in quality assurance of biotech/biopharmaceutical products.
* Based upon education, the Candidate should possess 0\-2 years of previous experience in any Sterile pharmaceutical Manufacturing, biotech sector, including biosimilars/any other biological products. Cell and gene therapy experience will be preferred.



  





**9\. Working Conditions:** 



* **Role Type:** 
 Full Time and Onsite
* **Work Hours:** 
 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM for the General Shift and 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM for the Post\-Noon Shift (on a rotational basis). There will be two days off each week, which may not necessarily fall on a Saturday or Sunday.
* **Travel Requirements:** 
 Occasional travel, subject to requirements.
* **Base Location:** 
 Immuneel Therapeutics Private Limited, 8th Floor, Mazumdar Shaw Medical Centre, Narayana Health City, Bommasandra Industrial Area, Bangalore – 560099

title: Officer-Quality Control
description:
Jubilant Pharma Limited is a global integrated pharmaceutical company offering a wide range of products and services to its customers across geographies. We organise our business into two segments, namely, Specialty Pharmaceuticals, comprising Radiopharmaceuticals (including Radio pharmacies), Contract Manufacturing of Sterile Injectable, Non\-sterile \& Allergy Therapy Products, and Generics \& APIs, comprising Solid Dosage Formulations \& Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients.
   

  

 Jubilant Generics (JGL) is a wholly \- owned subsidiary of Jubilant Pharma. JGL in India has Research \& Development units at Noida and Mysore. It has two manufacturing facilities one at Mysore, Karnataka and another at Roorkee, Uttarakhand, engaged in APIs and Dosage manufacturing, respectively.
   

  

 The manufacturing location at Mysore is spread over 69 acres and it’s a USFDA approved site engaged in manufacturing of APIs, and caters to the sales worldwide. API portfolio focusses on Lifestyle driven Therapeutic Areas (CVS, CNS) and targets complex and newly approved molecules. The company is the market leader in four APIs and is amongst the top three players for another three APIs in its portfolio helping it maintain a high contribution margin. The manufacturing location at Roorkee, Uttarakhand is state of the art facility and is audited and approved by USFDA, Japan PMDA, UK MHRA, TGA, WHO and Brazil ANVISA. This business focusses on B2B model for EU, Canada and emerging markets.
   

  

 Both manufacturing units are backward\- integrated and are supported by around 500 research and development professionals based at Noida and Mysore. R\&D works on Development of new products in API, Solid Dosage Formulations of Oral Solid, Sterile Injectable, Semi\-Solids Ointments, Creams and Liquids. All BA/BE studies are done In house at our 80 Bed facility which is inspected and having approvals /certifications from The Drugs Controller General (India) and has global regulatory accreditations including USFDA, EMEA, ANVISA (Brazil), INFRAMED (Portugal Authority), NPRA(Malaysia), AGES MEA (Austria) for GCP and NABL, CAP accreditations for Path lab services.
   

  

 JGL’s full\-fledged Regulatory Affairs \& IPR professionals ensures unique portfolio of patents and product filings in regulatory and non\-regulatory market.
   

  

 Revenue of Jubilant Pharma is constantly increasing and during the Financial Year 2018 \-19 it was INR 53,240 Million as compared to INR 39,950 Million during the Financial Year 2017\-18\.
   

  

 Kindly refer www.jubilantpharma.com for more information about organization.

 Reduce downtime and improve platform stability.
 



 Drive SRE\-oriented operational maturity.

 Ensure infrastructure hardening and operational compliance.
 



**Containerization \& Orchestration** 




 Manage Dockerized environments and orchestration platforms.
 



 Improve deployment consistency and environment portability.
 



 Support microservices architecture where applicable.
 



**Database \& Performance Optimization** 




 Work closely with backend and database teams on: Performance tuning Query optimization support Load balancing Caching strategies Replication and failover systems
 



**Team Leadership** 




 Lead and mentor DevOps engineers.
 



 Create operational SOPs and infrastructure standards.
 



 Build accountability, documentation culture, and ownership within the team.
 



 Coordinate with Development, QA, Support, and Product teams.
 



**Incident Management** 




 Handle production incidents with urgency and ownership.
 



 Build escalation systems and incident response frameworks.
 



 Conduct postmortem analysis and preventive planning.
 



**Required Technical Skills** 
**Strong Expertise In** 




 Linux Server Administration AWS / GCP / Azure Docker Kubernetes Jenkins / GitHub Actions / GitLab CI Nginx / Apache Load Balancers \& Reverse Proxies Networking \& Security Monitoring Tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Zabbix, etc.) Infrastructure Automation Shell Scripting / Python
 



**Good Understanding Of** 
 High\-availability architecture Distributed systems Scaling real\-time applications Database replication and clustering Message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis Streams, etc.) API infrastructure SSL, DNS, VPN, CDN, WAF

 Experience in IoT or telematics platforms Experience managing large\-scale real\-time tracking systems Terraform / Infrastructure as Code SRE practices Cost optimization at scale Multi\-region deployment experience
 



**Leadership Expectations** 




 This role is not for someone who only executes tickets.
 



 We expect the person to: Think proactively instead of reactively Build systems before problems become incidents Create operational leverage through automation Reduce dependency on manual intervention Build infrastructure that supports aggressive business growth Create visibility and measurable operational KPIs
 



**KPIs / Success Metrics** 




 The DevOps TL will be evaluated on: Platform uptime Deployment frequency \& stability MTTR (Mean Time to Recovery) Infrastructure scalability Security incident reduction Alert quality and monitoring maturity Automation coverage Infrastructure cost efficiency Team efficiency and operational discipline
 



**Experience Required** 
 5\+ years in DevOps / Infrastructure Engineering 2\+ years leading teams or handling critical production infrastructure Experience managing production SaaS environments at scale

 We are looking for someone who: Understands business impact of infrastructure decisions Can scale systems under uncertainty Handles pressure calmly during outages Builds processes, not heroics Has strong ownership mindset Can challenge poor engineering practices Thinks in terms of reliability engineering, not firefighting

 For us, it is a growth constraint or growth accelerator.
