description:
Position Type: Full Time
 



 Career Function: Human Resources
 



 Location: Dahej
 



  





**About the Role:**




 The incumbent for the Factories is responsible for overseeing all human resources functions at the Dahej manufacturing plant. This role is critical in supporting the operational goals of the factory by attracting, developing, and retaining a high\-performing workforce, ensuring compliance with labor laws, and fostering a positive and productive work environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in HR in a manufacturing or industrial setting, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with all levels of employees, from shop floor to senior management. The incumbent is expected to help Sigachi become an “Employer of Choice”.
 



  





**Key Job Responsibilities:**




  





 •
 **HR Policy \& Compliance**
 : Develop, implement, and enforce HR policies and procedures in alignment with company objectives and applicable labor laws and regulations (e.g., Factories Act, Industrial Disputes Act, EPF, ESI, Minimum Wages Act). Stay updated on changes in labor legislation and ensure factory operations are always compliant. Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with HR policies and statutory requirements. Prepare and submit necessary HR reports to government agencies as required.
 



  





 •
 **Employee Relations \& Engagement**
 : Serve as the primary point of contact for all employee relations matters, including grievances, disciplinary actions, and conflict resolution. Conduct thorough investigations and provide guidance to management on appropriate disciplinary measures, ensuring fairness and compliance with company policy and legal requirements. Promote a positive and inclusive work environment through various employee engagement initiatives. Advise management on performance management issues, including performance improvement plans and terminations.
 



  





 •
 **Performance Management \& Development**
 : Support factory management in implementing performance appraisal systems and processes. Identify training needs for factory employees and coordinate with relevant departments or external vendors to arrange appropriate training programs (e.g., safety training, skill development, leadership training for supervisors). Support career development initiatives for factory personnel.
 



  





 •
 **Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding**
 : Collaborate with factory management and corporate office to understand staffing needs and develop recruitment strategies for both permanent and contract roles (e.g., production operators, executives, supervisors, assistants). Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process, including job posting, resume screening, interviewing, and offer management. Develop and implement effective onboarding programs tailored for factory employees to ensure smooth integration and understanding of safety protocols, company policies, and job expectations.
 



  





 •
 **Compensation \& Benefits:**
 Administer compensation and benefits programs for factory employees, including payroll input, attendance management, shift allowances, and other factory\-specific benefits. \* Participate in salary surveys and provide recommendations for competitive compensation structures to attract and retain talent in the manufacturing sector. Ensure accurate and timely processing of HR\-related data for payroll and benefits administration.
 



  





 •
 **Environment, Health, Safety \& (EHS):**
 Work closely with the EHS department to ensure a safe working environment and compliance with all safety regulations. Participate in safety committee meetings and contribute to the development and implementation of safety policies and procedures. Assist in accident investigation from an HR perspective, ensuring proper documentation and support for employees.
 



  





 •
 **HR Administration \& Reporting**
 : Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records, both physical and digital. Prepare various HR reports and analytics (e.g., absenteeism, turnover, recruitment metrics) to support decision\-making. Manage HR aspects of factory shutdowns, expansions, or new line installations.
 



  





 •
 **Facilities Management:**
 Oversee the general maintenance and upkeep of factory premises, including office spaces, common areas, and utilities. Manage vendor relationships for facility services (e.g., cleaning, security, catering, maintenance).
 



  





**Job Specification:**




 • In\-depth knowledge of Indian labor laws, specifically the Factories Act, Industrial Disputes Act, EPF, ESI, Payment of Wages Act, Minimum Wages Act, Contract Labor (Regulation \& Abolition) Act, etc.
 



 • Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and the unique HR challenges within this sector.
 



 • Proficiency in HRIS systems and MS Office Suite (especially Excel).
 



 • Hands on experience in planning \& executing learning programs for front line workers, Supervisors, Middle Managers, Top Management.
 



 • Experience in managing end to end Performance Management System (PMS), including communication, implementation \& traction.
 



 • Knowledge about Talent management (Performance – Potential mapping) is an added advantage.
 



  





**Pre\-requisites:**




 • 15 – 20 years overall work experience, with at least 4 years in and Talent Management roles.
 



 • Graduate in any stream; MBA preferred.
 



 • Immaculate in English, Hindi, Gujrati.
 



 • Proficient in MS Office Suite – minimum intermediary level in Excel, PowerPoint \& Word.
 



 • Tech savvy – proven ability to use tech platforms to make impactful contributions.
 



 • High energy, ability to energize, creative \& learning mindset.
 



 • Strong problem\-solving and conflict resolution abilities.
 



 • Ability to build strong relationships with employees at all levels.
 



 • High level of integrity and ability to handle confidential information.
 



 • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
 



  





**About Sigachi**




 Sigachi Industries Limited is a Listed Healthcare Company working in domains of Pharmaceutical, Food \& Nutrition industry. Sigachi was incorporated in the year 1989 and is one of the largest manufacturers of Cellulose \& Cellulose based products worldwide. Recently Sigachi has acquired an API manufacturing plant as part of its diversification strategy. Sigachi’s five Multilocational facilities in Telangana, Gujarat \& Karnataka are EXCiPACT GMP, SGMP, HACCP, EDQM CEP, FSSAI and ISO 9001:2015 certified. Sigachi has established itself as a quality conscious and dependable supplier in India and across Asia, Australia, American Continent, Europe, and Middle East, delivering newer differentiated Products which addresses the unmet needs of the Market.
 



 Sigachi is a value driven company and fosters employee creativity, expertise, skillsets \& wellbeing to achieve motto of “Experience Excellence”. The vision is to create a happy, healthy, and joyful world. Sigachi is poised for exponential growth in the coming years, both organic \& inorganic through expansions, diversification, acquisition, mergers.
 



  





 Our Commitment to DEI: Sigachi is committed to cultivating, fostering, and preserving a culture of
 



 Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Our DEI based hiring \& people management practices thrive and hire
 



 people from diverse backgrounds with wide ideas and varied experience who can collectively contribute to overall business growth.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Job Title: HR Manager
 



 Location: Shahpur Jat, New Delhi
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time \| Work from Office
 



 Working Days: Monday to Saturday
 



 (1st \& 3rd Saturdays Off)
 



 Working Hours: 10:30 AM – 7:30 PM
 



 Experience: 4\+ Years
 



 Salary: ₹10 – ₹11 LPA
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on HR Manager to take ownership of the complete employee lifecycle, with a strong focus on talent acquisition, employee experience, culture and people development.
 



 The ideal candidate will work closely with the leadership team to build high\-quality human capital, strengthen HR processes and create a workplace where ambitious talent can thrive.
 



 Recruitment will be a key priority. You will lead hiring initiatives across departments, build strong talent pipelines and take direct ownership of key and senior\-level hires.
 



 You will be supported by a junior HR team member, while overall ownership of HR outcomes, quality and execution will rest with you.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment
 



 Lead and drive recruitment initiatives across departments and levels.
 



 Build and maintain strong talent pipelines.
 



 Work closely with leadership and department heads to understand hiring requirements.
 



 Develop effective hiring strategies aligned with business growth.
 



 Take direct ownership of critical and senior\-level hiring.
 



 Guide and supervise the junior HR team member handling day\-to\-day recruitment.
 



 Improve interview processes, candidate evaluation and overall candidate experience.
 



 Strengthen the company’s employer brand and attract high\-quality talent.
 



 2\. Culture \& Employee Experience
 



 Play an active role in shaping and strengthening the organisation’s culture.
 



 Act as a trusted bridge between employees and leadership.
 



 Create an environment where employees feel heard, valued and motivated.
 



 Identify workplace concerns and recommend practical solutions.
 



 Drive employee engagement and team\-building initiatives.
 



 Conduct feedback sessions and pulse checks.
 



 Implement initiatives focused on employee satisfaction and retention.
 



 3\. Strategic HR Leadership
 



 Lead the overall HR function with a focus on quality, accountability and people development.
 



 Partner with leadership to understand business growth plans and workforce requirements.
 



 Develop and improve HR processes, documentation and systems.
 



 Recommend and implement employee\-centric policies and people management frameworks.
 



 Draft and manage HR policies, employee communications and official documentation.
 



 4\. Performance \& People Development
 



 Work with department heads to manage structured performance reviews and feedback processes.
 



 Support managers in identifying high performers and development opportunities.
 



 Identify capability gaps and recommend appropriate development initiatives.
 



 Address underperformance constructively and systematically, including PIPs where required.
 



 Promote continuous learning and professional development.
 



 Coordinate internal workshops, learning initiatives and external training programmes.
 



 5\. Onboarding \& Employee Lifecycle
 



 Create a structured and engaging onboarding experience for new employees.
 



 Oversee induction, documentation, workspace readiness and cross\-team coordination.
 



 Personally support the onboarding of senior and key hires.
 



 Ensure smooth and professional employee offboarding.
 



 Manage employee lifecycle processes effectively from joining to exit.
 



 6\. HR Operations \& Compliance
 



 Oversee employee documentation, attendance, leave and payroll inputs.
 



 Ensure HR policies and internal processes are implemented consistently.
 



 Coordinate employee insurance and relevant HR vendors.
 



 Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records.
 



 Support the implementation and improvement of HRMS and other HR systems.
 



  





 Requirements
 



 4\+ years of relevant HR experience.
 



 Prior experience in an advertising, marketing, creative or communications agency is highly preferred.
 



 Strong understanding of the agency ecosystem, its pace and talent requirements.
 



 Proven experience in recruitment and talent acquisition.
 



 Ability to identify quality talent beyond CV and JD matching.
 



 Strong interpersonal, communication and conflict\-resolution skills.
 



 Excellent people management and relationship\-building abilities.
 



 High ownership, maturity and discretion when handling sensitive matters.
 



 Hands\-on and solution\-oriented approach.
 



 Ability to work directly with leadership and build trust across teams.
 



 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 



 Proficiency in Google Workspace, MS Office, HRMS and other workplace tools.
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone who wants to build, not just manage.
 



 The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable participating in leadership discussions about organisational growth and stepping in to solve an urgent hiring, employee or people\-related challenge.
 



 If you understand the energy of agency life, enjoy building strong teams and want to take real ownership of an organisation’s people journey, we’d love to hear from you.
 



  





 Why Join Us?
 



 Opportunity to take ownership of the complete HR function.
 



 Direct exposure to leadership and strategic decision\-making.
 



 Opportunity to shape culture and people processes in a growing agency.
 



 Significant ownership of talent acquisition and team building.
 



 Fast\-paced, creative and growth\-oriented work environment.

title: Manager, Human Resources
description:
**Job Description**
 At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one\-of\-a\-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
   

  

 EisnerAmper is seeking a HR Business Partner (HRBP) who will act as a strategic advisor and trusted partner to business leaders, aligning people strategy with business objectives. The role is responsible for managing an entire employee lifecycle from onboarding to exit.
   

  

 Key activities involve conducting employee connects, managing MIS and holding HR dashboard reviews, formulating retention strategy, employee engagement initiatives and creating a positive employee experience while ensuring robust HR governance and proactive approach.
   

  

**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**
* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards
+ We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions
+ We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
+ Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work
+ Numerous Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support our Diversity, Equity, \& Inclusion (DE\&I) efforts


 We strongly believe in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, EisnerAmper is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or protected veteran status, citizenship, or other protected characteristics under federal, state, or local law.
   

  

**About our Human Resources Team:**
 Comprised of five centers of excellence and a diverse team of backgrounds and experience, the EisnerAmper Human Resources department attracts top talent, creates impactful engagement opportunities, and promotes education and growth for employees across the firm. By bringing together unique HR specializations and a deep understanding of the accounting business, we can enable our colleagues to thrive personally and professionally.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is based on the tenets of respect, professionalism and extreme hospitality. While people are at the heart of everything we do, don’t mistake us for your typical HR department. We’re constantly looking for ways to leverage advanced data and analytics, implement innovative technology, and roll out new processes that scale with the business.
   

  

 EisnerAmper HR employees act as strategic partners with the service lines with which they work to create and deliver real business solutions. Because when we have a genuine understanding of the unique teams and individuals we serve, we can make a tangible difference and deliver on our promise of being a great place to work.
   

  

**What Work You Will be Responsible For:**
**Business \& HR Strategy Alignment**
* Partner with leadership teams to understand business goals and translate them into effective HR strategies and people initiatives.
* Use people analytics and employee insights to support business decisions and improve organizational effectiveness.


**New Joiner Assimilation \& Onboarding**
* Own and continuously improve end\-to\-end new joiner assimilation programs.
* Partner with managers to ensure smooth onboarding, role clarity, and early engagement.
* Track and improve new hire experience, productivity ramp‑up, and early attrition metrics.


**Understanding Employee Pulse**
* Proactively connect with employees and regularly assess organizational pulse through surveys, feedback forums, and informal conversations.
* Identify emerging concerns early and partner with leadership to address them proactively.
* Ensure consistent communication between management and employees.


**Employee Relations \& Grievance Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for employee concerns, grievances, and workplace issues.
* Manage grievance processes with fairness, confidentiality, and compliance inline with company policies and labor laws.
* Facilitate effective conflict resolution and promote a culture of trust, transparency, and respect.


**Manager Coaching \& Capability Building**
* Coach people managers on performance management, employee engagement, difficult conversations, and leadership effectiveness.
* Support managers in handling complex employee situations with empathy and consistency.
* Drive adoption of HR frameworks, policies, and best practices across the business.


**Attrition Management \& Retention**
* Partner with leaders to analyze attrition trends, identify root causes, and build targeted action plans.
* Conduct stay interviews and exit analysis to strengthen retention strategies.
* Design and implement initiatives to improve employee commitment, morale, and career growth.


**Employee Engagement Activities**
* Plan and execute engagement initiatives in collaboration with business leaders and central HR teams.
* Promote inclusion, collaboration, recognition, and well\-being initiatives.
* Measure engagement outcomes and recommend interventions based on voice survey feedback and pulse data.


**Key Stakeholders**
* Business Leaders \& Line Managers
* Employees across levels
* Central HR \& Admin teams (Talent Acquisition, L\&D, HR Operations)


**Basic Qualifications For The Opportunity**
* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources or a related field
* 7\-9 years of progressive HR experience, with significant experience in an HR Business Partner role
* Hands\-on experience in employee relations, analytics, and working closely with senior leaders


**About EisnerAmper:**
 EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 4,000 employees and more than 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long\-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
   

  

 Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start\-ups, global public firms, and middle\-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not\-for\-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.
   

  

**About EisnerAmper India:**

Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one\-of\-a\-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
   

  

 EisnerAmper is seeking a HR Business Partner (HRBP) who will act as a strategic advisor and trusted partner to business leaders, aligning people strategy with business objectives. The role is responsible for managing an entire employee lifecycle from onboarding to exit.
   

  

 Key activities involve conducting employee connects, managing MIS and holding HR dashboard reviews, formulating retention strategy, employee engagement initiatives and creating a positive employee experience while ensuring robust HR governance and proactive approach.
   

  

**What It Means To Work For EisnerAmper**
* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards
+ We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions
+ We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
+ Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work
+ Numerous Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support our Diversity, Equity, \& Inclusion (DE\&I) efforts


 We strongly believe in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, EisnerAmper is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or protected veteran status, citizenship, or other protected characteristics under federal, state, or local law.
   

  

**About Our Human Resources Team**
 Comprised of five centers of excellence and a diverse team of backgrounds and experience, the EisnerAmper Human Resources department attracts top talent, creates impactful engagement opportunities, and promotes education and growth for employees across the firm. By bringing together unique HR specializations and a deep understanding of the accounting business, we can enable our colleagues to thrive personally and professionally.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is based on the tenets of respect, professionalism and extreme hospitality. While people are at the heart of everything we do, don’t mistake us for your typical HR department. We’re constantly looking for ways to leverage advanced data and analytics, implement innovative technology, and roll out new processes that scale with the business.
   

  

 EisnerAmper HR employees act as strategic partners with the service lines with which they work to create and deliver real business solutions. Because when we have a genuine understanding of the unique teams and individuals we serve, we can make a tangible difference and deliver on our promise of being a great place to work.
   

  

**What Work You Will Be Responsible For**
**Business \& HR Strategy Alignment**
* Partner with leadership teams to understand business goals and translate them into effective HR strategies and people initiatives.
* Use people analytics and employee insights to support business decisions and improve organizational effectiveness.


**New Joiner Assimilation \& Onboarding**
* Own and continuously improve end\-to\-end new joiner assimilation programs.
* Partner with managers to ensure smooth onboarding, role clarity, and early engagement.
* Track and improve new hire experience, productivity ramp‑up, and early attrition metrics.


**Understanding Employee Pulse**
* Proactively connect with employees and regularly assess organizational pulse through surveys, feedback forums, and informal conversations.
* Identify emerging concerns early and partner with leadership to address them proactively.
* Ensure consistent communication between management and employees.


**Employee Relations \& Grievance Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for employee concerns, grievances, and workplace issues.
* Manage grievance processes with fairness, confidentiality, and compliance inline with company policies and labor laws.
* Facilitate effective conflict resolution and promote a culture of trust, transparency, and respect.


**Manager Coaching \& Capability Building**
* Coach people managers on performance management, employee engagement, difficult conversations, and leadership effectiveness.
* Support managers in handling complex employee situations with empathy and consistency.
* Drive adoption of HR frameworks, policies, and best practices across the business.


**Attrition Management \& Retention**
* Partner with leaders to analyze attrition trends, identify root causes, and build targeted action plans.
* Conduct stay interviews and exit analysis to strengthen retention strategies.
* Design and implement initiatives to improve employee commitment, morale, and career growth.


**Employee Engagement Activities**
* Plan and execute engagement initiatives in collaboration with business leaders and central HR teams.
* Promote inclusion, collaboration, recognition, and well\-being initiatives.
* Measure engagement outcomes and recommend interventions based on voice survey feedback and pulse data.


**Key Stakeholders**
* Business Leaders \& Line Managers
* Employees across levels
* Central HR \& Admin teams (Talent Acquisition, L\&D, HR Operations)


**Basic Qualifications For The Opportunity**
* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources or a related field
* 7\-9 years of progressive HR experience, with significant experience in an HR Business Partner role
* Hands\-on experience in employee relations, analytics, and working closely with senior leaders


**About EisnerAmper**
 EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 4,000 employees and more than 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long\-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
   

  

 Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start\-ups, global public firms, and middle\-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not\-for\-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.
   

  

**About EisnerAmper India**
 EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non\-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
   

  

 EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007\. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Ahmedabad, Bangalore and Hyderabad. title: Global People Support - Team Lead
description:
**About The Job**
 Who are we?
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. Stripe’s People \& Places Operations team will sit within the SDC and is a highly collaborative, cross\-functional team that drives key support for the People and Places function. We work with many different teams at Stripe. We are nimble and flexible individuals that can wear many different hats. We don’t mind working through ambiguity and love adding organization to chaos. We believe that success is not defined by any one individual, but rather by the collective work of the entire team.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide strategic HR leadership to HR Operations. Effectively manage, develop and engage the global team
* Ensure an exceptional employee experience by simplifying key processes
* Lead and implement HR initiatives and projects which are aligned within HR and Centers of Expertise (COE)
* Coordinate and lead key projects for improvement across HR
* Identify best practices that can be applied to improve work tasks and processes
* Deliver service improvement activity across HR through employing process improvement methodologies and the application of innovative thinking
* Promote and lead change
* Supports the administration and maintenance of HR systems while driving process and data integrity across the HR landscape
* Participate in and/or lead projects aimed at expanding centralization, leverage technology to improve the employee experience, and discover actionable insights and recommend solutions
* Responsible for driving process consistency, data integrity and compliance to HR policies, procedures, data privacy, audit controls and regulatory requirements in all HR Service Center activities
* Serves as the escalation point for HR Operations guiding the root cause analysis, resolution and communication protocol
* Manage the case management system (Ops ticketing system) and team to establish service level agreements
* Partner with the HRIS team supporting HR technology upgrades
* Develop and maintain team standard operating procedures
* Oversees relevant employee data management to ensure that data is secure and maintained consistent with company policies and privacy regulations and that required reporting and filings are delivered
* Track HR metrics to identify areas for improvement. Develop and implement counter\-measures to correct identified misses to goals


**Skills**
* Proficiency in verbal \& written communication in English
* Good working knowledge of MS Office, MS Outlook; MS Excel. Proficiency is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to analyze and identify patterns in large data sets.
* Decision making aptitudes based on given guidelines and in ambiguous contexts.
* Must be comfortable working with large data sets.
* Very good knowledge and experience in internet navigation and research – finding specific information about products in a timely manner.


**Minimum Requirements**
* Minimum 5\+ years of people and operations management experience
* Education \- Grad/Post Grad in human resources or a related discipline
* Desired 8\+ years of experience in People Operations
* Experience with HR systems such as Workday, Greenhouse, Confluence and Salesforce
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision
* Excellent leadership skills, data analytical \& presentation skills, written \& Communication skills
* Understanding of overall HR lifecycle – Core HR, Benefits, Talent Mobility, Equity, Compensation, Exits, etc.


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

title: Work Force Management - Reporting Professional
description:
**Summary**
 This role is strictly involved in business analysis, requirements documentation, and healthcare reference data support activities and does not involve direct access to Protected Health Information (PHI), Personally Identifiable Information (PII), or any secured or confidential client data. The work is limited to analysis of healthcare claims, reference code sets, and system configurations using governed datasets and does not include handling or processing of sensitive health or personal information.
   

  

 You are responsible for producing, validating, and distributing Workforce Management reporting that helps leaders understand service performance, workforce efficiency, forecast accuracy, adherence, productivity, and operational risk.
   

  

 This role supports recurring WFM reporting, service performance reporting, agent\-level reporting, report quality assurance, data presentation, and continuous improvement insights. It partners with operations, WFM, Finance, training, quality, technology, and global delivery teams to ensure reporting is accurate, timely, actionable, and aligned to business needs.
   

  

**Your role in our mission**
**Recurring WFM \& Service Performance Reporting**
 Produce, validate, or govern recurring Workforce Management reports for operational leaders and stakeholders.
   

  

 Report on SLA attainment, response times, backlog trends, forecast accuracy, occupancy, productivity, adherence, schedule compliance, and operational risks.
   

  

 Ensure reports are timely, consistent, and aligned to defined metric logic and stakeholder expectations.
   

  

**Agent\-Level, Team\-Level \& Operational Insights**
 Generate or review agent, team, site, channel, and function\-level reports that highlight productivity, utilization, adherence, occupancy, and schedule compliance.
   

  

 Identify meaningful patterns, trends, anomalies, and risks in workforce data.
   

  

 Translate reporting outcomes into practical recommendations that leaders can act on.
   

  

**Data Quality, Governance \& Visualization**
 Ensure data accuracy, consistency, integrity, and clear documentation across reporting outputs.
   

  

 Apply standard definitions, report QA routines, metric logic, and validation checks.
   

  

 Use Excel, Power BI, Verint reporting outputs, and other visualization tools to present data clearly and effectively.
   

  

**Stakeholder Communication \& Continuous Improvement**
 Present findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including operations leaders and cross\-functional partners.
   

  

 Partner with WFM, operations, Finance, training, quality, technology, and global delivery teams to improve reporting usability and decision quality.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 1\+ years of workforce management, contact center, operational planning, reporting, analytics, or related customer experience operations experience.
* Demonstrated capability in supporting assigned work accurately, following established processes, and identifying risks early.
* Experience supporting WFM reporting, analytics, dashboarding, and data storytelling activities in complex, multi\-site, omnichannel, back\-office, healthcare, insurance, or BPO service environments.
* Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain workforce insights to operational and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working in hybrid U.S./global delivery models or cross\-functional operational environments.
* Working knowledge of Verint reporting outputs, Excel, Power BI at senior levels, and operational dashboards; NICE knowledge is also preferred but not required.


**What You Should Expect In This Role**
 Remote role able to support across U.S. time zones and global delivery partnership needs.
   

  

 Regular collaboration with operations, WFM, training, quality, reporting, technology, and Finance partners as appropriate.
   

  

 Opportunity to improve service performance, workforce planning discipline, operational credibility, and customer experience outcomes.
